jobs.title: Team Leader (Business Manager) - Bangka
jobs.description: Description Kami mencari Business Manager (Team Leader) yang berpengalaman untuk memimpin dan mengawasi pekerjaan karyawan di perusahaan kami. Tugas utama adalah bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan efisiensi operasi bisnis serta menetapkan tujuan strategis kedepannya. Selain itu juga harus memiliki kompetensi memberikan bimbingan untuk peningkatan kinerja, dengan cara yang menggabungkan visi dan budaya perusahaan. Tujuannya adalah untuk memastikan profitabilitas kegiatan perusahaan kami untuk mendorong pembangunan berkelanjutan dan kesuksesan jangka panjang. Tanggungjawab Kerja: Melakukan monitoring terhadap tim marketing/business partner dalam hal kinerja dan pencapaian target Melakukan market review dan menjalankan strategi untuk mencapai target yang ditetapkan Bertanggung jawab atas proses bisnis dalam hal SOP, baik secara administrasi maupun di lapangan. Bertanggung jawab atas portofolio cabang/point secara kualitas dan kuantitas Bertanggung jawab atas soliditas tim dan mampu me-manage konflik internal tim atas dasar peraturan perusahaan. Bersedia ditempatkan di seluruh Bangka Belitung Requirements Pendidikan terakhir minimum Diploma Memiliki pengalaman bertanggung jawab dalam memimpin tim min 2th Berpengalaman memimpin lebih dari 5-10 anggota tim Memiliki pengalaman min 2 tahun di Micro Finance sebagai Manager (Lembaga Keuangan Sistem Grameen) Dapat menyusun strategi sales & marketing sebagai paduan tim untuk mencapai target Mempunyai motor dan sim C aktif Kemampuan yang Dibutuhkan: Disiplin Tinggi (berintegritas, jujur & transparan) Memiliki kekuatan komunikasi & berkolaborasi dengan tim Memiliki semangat belajar yg tinggi terutama untuk menganalisa informasi dan data Mudah beradaptasi pada perubahan dan berorientasi pada target Mampu membangun budaya coaching untuk meningkatkan performa tim

jobs.title: MAINTENANCE
jobs.description: Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3 Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang terkait . Memiliki pengalaman kerja di KCP, PKS, atau industri pengolahan menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, dan troubleshooting mesin. Memiliki kemampuan dalam perawatan dan perbaikan screw conveyor, expeller/press, ripple mill, kernel crusher, filter press, pompa, motor listrik, gearbox, bearing, coupling, serta hydraulic system . Mampu membaca gambar teknik dan wiring diagram . Memahami penggunaan tools dan alat ukur maintenance. Memahami dan menerapkan K3 dalam pekerjaan. Bersedia bekerja shift dan menangani kondisi breakdown. Memiliki kemampuan analisis, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia ditempatkan sesuai kebutuhan operasional perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab Melaksanakan preventive dan corrective maintenance pada mesin dan peralatan. Melakukan inspeksi rutin dan troubleshooting terhadap gangguan mesin. Menangani breakdown dan memastikan mesin dapat kembali beroperasi dengan aman dan optimal. Melakukan pencatatan dan pelaporan pekerjaan maintenance. Menjaga ketersediaan dan kondisi peralatan serta spare part yang diperlukan. Memastikan seluruh pekerjaan dilakukan sesuai SOP dan standar K3 .

jobs.title: STAFF MAINTENANCE
jobs.description: Kualifikasi : SMK/D3/S1 Teknik Elektro, Elektronika, Mekatronika, Mesin, atau terkait. Fresh graduate dipersilakan; pengalaman maintenance manufaktur menjadi nilai tambah. Mampu membaca electrical drawing, wiring diagram, line diagram, serta memahami PLC/HMI dasar. Memahami motor, inverter/VFD, servo, actuator, sensor, pneumatik, hidrolik, dan sistem mekanik mesin. Mampu melakukan preventive, corrective, troubleshooting, dan improvement mesin secara sistematis. Mampu menggunakan alat ukur seperti multimeter, clamp meter, jangka sorong, mikrometer, dan torque wrench. Memahami K3, LOTO, APD, serta siap bekerja shift. Menguasai Microsoft Office; kemampuan PLC (Mitsubishi/Omron/Siemens) menjadi nilai tambah. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja dalam tim. Jobdesk : - Melakukan pemeriksaan, pemeliharaan, dan perbaikan peralatan produksi secara berkala serta mencatat log pemeliharaan - Cepat menanggapi troubleshooting untuk effisiensi waktu downtime - Membantu mengembangkan perawatan mesin secara optimal serta memberikan saran

jobs.title: Junior Architect
jobs.description: About the role The Junior Architect translates concepts, sketches, and rough calculations from architects, engineers, and designers into precise technical drawings and specifications. Acting as the bridge between design and execution, the Drafter creates detailed drawings, 3D models, and construction schematics that guide field teams and contractors during building or manufacturing. Key responsibilities Prepare accurate construction drawings (shop drawings, as-built drawings, structural/architectural details) using ArchiCAD/AutoCAD / Revit / SketchUp. Collaborate closely with project managers, site engineers, and architects to translate concepts into technical plans. Perform site visits and field measurements when required. Revise drawings based on client feedback and structural/site requirements. Maintain organized drawing archives and project documentation. Requirements: Minimum 2–3 years of experience in construction drafting or architectural detailing. Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, or relevant technical field (or equivalent proven experience). Expert in ArchiCAD, AutoCAD 2D/3D. Proficiency in SketchUp, Revit, or 3ds Max is a strong plus. Strong understanding of building materials, construction techniques, and structural detailing. Good communication skills and ability to meet project deadlines. Currently residing in or willing to relocate to Bali. Good English proficiency is a plus. Benefits Competitive salary Performance bonuses & project incentives. BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan. Career advancement in a fast-growing construction firm. About us PT Coastal Jasa Konstruksi is a dynamic and growing construction company committed to delivering excellence across infrastructure and development projects.

jobs.title: Freelance Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Company Description PT. Basukigraha Fabrikatama (BGF) in Indonesia is a leading manufacturer of modular building solutions such as electrical houses/power control rooms and steel structures for various industries such as power plants, mining, oil and gas, railways and data centres. First established in 1996, we successfully delivered projects for multinational corporations such as Schneider Electric and Siemens, serving both local and international markets. Role Description This freelance sales and business development position allows for work-from-anywhere flexibility and is ideal for experienced professionals with strong, relevant industry networks. You will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building and maintaining client relationships, and executing strategic sales initiatives to expand our market presence. Why Join Us? 1. High earning potential – Competitive commission for every successful project win. 2. Work-from-anywhere flexibility – No fixed office hours or location requirements. 3. Long-term potential – Opportunity for continued collaboration based on performance. Key Responsibilities 1. Identify high-value business opportunities – engage with relevant contractors, project owners in the mining, oil and gas, data center, power generation and transportation infrastructure industries. 2. Develop strategic partnerships – build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers in the relevant industrial and energy sectors. 3. Lead project sales cycles – manage bids, technical discussions, negotiations and deal closures. 4. Provide market insights & strategy – Provide advice on upcoming projects, competitor trends and industry shifts to optimize market penetration. 5. jobs.title: Asisten Sin She
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Asisten Sin She yang berdedikasi dan terampil untuk bergabung dengan tim Teknik Lingkungan kami di Jakarta Utara. Posisi ini memainkan peran penting dalam mendukung operasi dan proyek-proyek teknik lingkungan yang strategis bagi perusahaan kami. Sebagai Asisten Sin She, Anda akan bekerja sama dengan tim profesional untuk memastikan keberhasilan implementasi solusi lingkungan yang inovatif dan berkelanjutan. Jabatan ini menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkembang dalam industri teknik lingkungan sambil berkontribusi pada inisiatif-inisiatif yang berdampak positif terhadap lingkungan. Tanggung Jawab Utama Membantu dalam persiapan dan pengumpulan data teknis untuk proyek-proyek teknik lingkungan. Mendukung tim dalam monitoring dan evaluasi kepatuhan terhadap standar lingkungan yang berlaku. Melakukan dokumentasi dan pencatatan hasil pengamatan lapangan serta analisis data lingkungan. Membantu dalam koordinasi antara berbagai departemen dan pemangku kepentingan terkait isu-isu lingkungan. Mendukung persiapan laporan teknis dan presentasi yang berkaitan dengan proyek lingkungan. Melakukan inspeksi lapangan dan melakukan pengamatan untuk memastikan kualitas pekerjaan teknik lingkungan. Membantu dalam pengembangan dan implementasi sistem manajemen lingkungan yang efektif. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau gelar Sarjana di bidang Teknik Lingkungan, Teknik Sipil, atau bidang terkait dengan fokus pada lingkungan. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik tentang regulasi dan standar lingkungan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Kemampuan komunikasi yang kuat, baik lisan maupun tertulis, dalam bahasa Indonesia. Keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang baik untuk menangani multiple tasks. Kemampuan analitis dan perhatian terhadap detail dalam menangani data dan dokumentasi teknis. Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun di bidang teknik lingkungan atau proyek-proyek terkait lingkungan menjadi nilai tambah. Keterampilan menggunakan software dan tools teknis untuk analisis data lingkungan. Kemauan untuk terus belajar dan berkembang dalam bidang teknik lingkungan dan praktik berkelanjutan.

jobs.title: PPIC & Logistics Supervisor
jobs.description: Kami perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang fabrikasi dan instalasi pintu, jendela, serta facade aluminium & kaca sedang mencari kandidat profesional dan berpengalaman untuk mengisi posisi PPIC & Logistics Supervisor. TANGGUNG JAWAB UTAMA: - Menginput LPB (Lembar Penerimaan Barang) dan melakukan costing material di program akuntansi. - Menerjemahkan Perintah Produksi (Cutting & Assembly List) dari Tim Teknik menjadi BonPengeluaran Bahan. - Menugaskan dan mengawasi tim gudang dalam penyiapan dan pengeluaran barang. - Mengelola jadwal pengiriman (delivery schedule) dan berkoordinasi langsung dengan supirlogistik. - Memastikan akurasi stok barang gudang sesuai dengan data sistem secara berkala. KUALIFIKASI: - Usia maks. 38 tahun. - Pendidikan min. jobs.title: TRANSLATOR MANDARIN
jobs.description: Tugas dan tanggung jawab: Menerjemahkan dokumen, surat, laporan, instruksi kerja, dan materi perusahaan dari Mandarin ↔ Indonesia. Melakukan interpretasi langsung dalam meeting, briefing, kunjungan kerja, atau komunikasi antara karyawan Indonesia dan Tiongkok. Membantu komunikasi antara manajemen, staf, supplier, customer, dan pihak terkait yang menggunakan Bahasa Mandarin. Memastikan hasil terjemahan memiliki makna, istilah teknis, dan konteks yang tepat. Membantu menjelaskan instruksi atau informasi dari pihak Mandarin kepada karyawan Indonesia. Menjaga kerahasiaan dokumen dan informasi perusahaan. Melakukan pengecekan dan proofreading hasil terjemahan sebelum digunakan. Membantu pekerjaan administrasi atau tugas lain yang berkaitan dengan komunikasi Mandarin sesuai kebutuhan perusahaan. Kualifikasi umum: Menguasai Bahasa Mandarin dan Bahasa Indonesia secara lisan dan tulisan. Memiliki kemampuan Mandarin–Indonesia dan Indonesia–Mandarin . Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik dan memahami konteks budaya kedua bahasa. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Pengalaman sebagai translator/interpreter menjadi nilai tambah. Sertifikat HSK dapat menjadi nilai tambah, terutama untuk posisi yang membutuhkan kemampuan Mandarin profesional.

jobs.description: R&D TEKNOLOGI PANGAN – SUSU BUBUK Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari profesional berpengalaman untuk bergabung sebagai R&D Teknologi Pangan dalam pengembangan dan optimasi produk susu bubuk di fasilitas produksi kami di Sragen, Jawa Tengah. Posisi ini memiliki peran penting dalam pengembangan formulasi, optimasi proses spray drying , troubleshooting produk, serta scale-up dari trial hingga produksi komersial. Tanggung Jawab Mengembangkan dan mengoptimalkan formulasi produk susu bubuk. Melakukan trial dan optimasi proses spray drying . Menentukan dan mengoptimalkan parameter proses untuk menghasilkan powder dengan kualitas yang konsisten. Melakukan troubleshooting terhadap masalah seperti kelarutan rendah, lumping, stickiness, higroskopisitas, perubahan warna, rasa, dan yield . Melakukan pengembangan produk dari skala laboratorium hingga scale-up ke produksi . Melakukan evaluasi karakteristik bahan baku dan produk jadi. Melakukan pengujian fisik dan kimia produk sesuai kebutuhan R&D. Bekerja sama dengan Production dan QC untuk menyelesaikan permasalahan kualitas dan proses. Membuat dan menjaga dokumentasi formulasi, parameter proses, hasil trial, dan spesifikasi produk. Melakukan continuous improvement terhadap kualitas, efisiensi proses, dan cost produk. Melakukan research terhadap bahan baku dan teknologi baru untuk pengembangan produk. Kualifikasi Wajib Minimal S1 Teknologi Pangan, Food Science, Teknik Kimia, Kimia , atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman di industri susu bubuk, dairy powder, atau industri powdered dairy products. Berpengalaman langsung dalam proses spray drying , bukan hanya pengetahuan teoritis. Memahami formulasi dan karakteristik milk powder . Memahami permasalahan powder seperti solubility, moisture, hygroscopicity, caking, stickiness, bulk density, dan flowability . Memiliki pengalaman melakukan trial, troubleshooting, dan scale-up proses produksi . Mampu membaca dan menganalisis hasil pengujian laboratorium. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri dan bertanggung jawab terhadap hasil pengembangan produk. Bersedia bekerja onsite di Sragen, Jawa Tengah . Kandidat yang Kami Cari Kami mencari profesional yang sudah terbiasa bekerja dengan susu bubuk dan spray drying secara langsung . Kandidat ideal bukan hanya memahami teori formulasi, tetapi mampu menentukan parameter proses, melakukan trial, menemukan penyebab masalah powder, dan membawa formulasi dari tahap R&D hingga berhasil diproduksi secara konsisten. Pengalaman langsung di industri susu bubuk merupakan persyaratan wajib.

jobs.title: Staf IT
jobs.description: Gambaran Umum Pekerjaan Kami mencari seorang Staf IT yang berdedikasi dan terampil untuk bergabung dengan tim teknologi informasi PT Star Parts Motor di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Posisi ini merupakan peran strategis yang bertanggung jawab untuk mendukung infrastruktur jaringan dan sistem IT perusahaan kami, memastikan operasional bisnis berjalan lancar tanpa gangguan. Sebagai Staf IT, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung teknologi kami, mengelola, memelihara, dan mengoptimalkan sistem jaringan untuk mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis yang berkelanjutan. Jabatan ini adalah posisi penuh waktu yang memerlukan kehadiran di lokasi kami di Bandung, Jawa Barat. Tanggung Jawab Utama Mengelola dan memelihara infrastruktur jaringan perusahaan, termasuk server, switch, router, dan perangkat jaringan lainnya untuk memastikan konektivitas yang stabil dan optimal. Melakukan monitoring sistem IT secara rutin dan proaktif untuk mendeteksi serta mengatasi masalah teknis sebelum berdampak pada operasional bisnis. Memberikan dukungan teknis kepada pengguna internal, menangani tiket support, dan menyelesaikan masalah hardware dan software dengan efisien. Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, dan troubleshooting perangkat jaringan serta sistem informasi sesuai dengan standar perusahaan. Mengelola backup data dan memastikan sistem recovery yang berfungsi dengan baik untuk menjaga keamanan dan integritas data perusahaan. Melakukan update keamanan, patch sistem, dan maintenance rutin pada server dan jaringan untuk mencegah kerentanan keamanan. Mendokumentasikan konfigurasi jaringan, prosedur teknis, dan incident reports untuk keperluan audit dan referensi. Berkolaborasi dengan vendor IT dan pihak eksternal lainnya untuk implementasi solusi teknologi baru. Keterampilan, Kualifikasi, dan Pengalaman yang Dibutuhkan Diploma atau Gelar Sarjana dalam bidang Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Jaringan, atau bidang terkait yang relevan. Fresh graduate Menguasai Coding Kemampuan troubleshooting hardware dan software, serta problem solving yang kuat. Kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan bahasa Inggris teknis. Sikap proaktif, responsif terhadap masalah, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan dengan deadline yang ketat. Pengetahuan tentang keamanan informasi, firewall, dan best practices dalam cybersecurity adalah nilai tambah. Manfaat Utama Perusahaan Kesempatan untuk pengembangan karier dan pelatihan teknis berkelanjutan Lingkungan kerja yang profesional dan mendukung dengan tim yang solid dan kolaboratif. Kesempatan magang dan learning opportunities dalam teknologi jaringan dan infrastruktur IT terbaru. Work-life balance yang sehat dengan jam kerja yang teratur dan istirahat yang cukup. Tentang Kami PT Star Parts Motor adalah perusahaan terkemuka dalam industri otomotif yang menyediakan komponen dan suku cadang berkualitas tinggi. Dengan komitmen terhadap inovasi, kualitas, dan kepuasan pelanggan, kami telah membangun reputasi yang solid di pasar. Perusahaan kami menjunjung tinggi nilai integritas, profesionalisme, dan kerja sama tim. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam kesuksesan perusahaan. Budaya kerja kami mendorong kreativitas, pembelajaran berkelanjutan, dan pertumbuhan personal setiap karyawan. Kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif dan merata, di mana setiap individu memiliki kesempatan untuk berkembang dan mencapai potensi terbaiknya. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kriteria di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim IT kami, kami mengundang Anda untuk mengirimkan lamaran Anda. Persiapkan CV, surat lamaran, dan portofolio teknis (jika ada) Anda dan lamar sekarang untuk menjadi bagian dari tim PT Star Parts Motor. Kami menantikan untuk mengenal Anda lebih lanjut!

jobs.title: Frontliner
jobs.description: PT. Rumah Bersama Seluler adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang retail yang menyediakan produk Apple dengan garansi resmi. Kami mencari individu yang kompeten dan antusias untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Serengan, Surakarta, Jawa Tengah. Kesempatan ini cocok bagi mereka yang ingin berkembang dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan penuh tantangan, serta memiliki passion dalam bidang penjualan dan pelayanan pelanggan. Sebagai Frontliner, Anda akan menjadi ujung tombak perusahaan dalam memberikan layanan terbaik kepada pelanggan. Tugas utama Anda meliputi menerima dan memahami kebutuhan pelanggan, menjelaskan produk dan layanan secara efektif, membantu proses transaksi, serta menjaga hubungan baik dengan pelanggan agar mereka merasa puas dan kembali menggunakan layanan kami. Anda juga akan berperan dalam menyukseskan strategi penjualan dan pemasaran yang telah ditetapkan oleh perusahaan.

Berkolaborasi dengan influencer, vendor, dan stakeholder lainnya untuk memperluas jangkauan konten.

jobs.title: Supervisor Bengkel (Workshop Supervisor) - Machining & Fabrication
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan Kami mencari Supervisor Bengkel yang kuat secara teknis dan mampu memimpin langsung di lapangan untuk mengatur jalannya operasional harian bengkel. Tanggung jawab utama: Mengatur dan mengawasi operasional harian seluruh department bengkel: bubut, milling, las, bending & rolling, boring/grinding, fabrikasi, dan in-situ machining Menerjemahkan Job Order menjadi pembagian kerja harian per department: penugasan operator, alokasi mesin, dan target penyelesaian Mengatur alokasi tenaga kerja karyawan lapangan Memantau progress pekerjaan terhadap target delivery dan melaporkan status harian kepada Manajemen Memeriksa kualitas dan dimensi hasil kerja sebelum barang diserahkan ke customer, memastikan sesuai gambar dan toleransi Berkoordinasi dengan bagian Purchasing untuk kebutuhan material, consumable, dan tooling Memastikan perawatan mesin berjalan sesuai jadwal serta melaporkan kerusakan dan downtime Menegakkan disiplin kerja, penerapan K3 dan pemakaian APD, serta kebersihan dan kerapian area kerja Membimbing dan meningkatkan kemampuan operator, serta menyelesaikan permasalahan yang timbul di lapangan Kualifikasi: Memiliki latar belakang pendidikan atau pelatihan di bidang teknik mesin / pemesinan Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun sebagai Supervisor, Kepala Regu, atau Foreman di bengkel bubut, machine shop, atau workshop fabrikasi. Pengalaman di industri marine, oil & gas, atau perbaikan komponen mesin lebih diutamakan Menguasai proses kerja bengkel secara teknis Mampu membaca gambar teknik serta memahami toleransi dan fit & finish Terbiasa menggunakan alat ukur presisi: jangka sorong, mikrometer, dial indicator, bore gauge Memahami proses bubut (konvensional), milling, boring, grinding, bending dan rolling Memahami proses pengelasan (SMAW / GTAW / GMAW) serta karakter material mild steel, carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminium, dan brass/bronze Mampu memperkirakan waktu pengerjaan (jam mesin dan jam orang) serta menentukan prioritas antar pekerjaan yang berjalan bersamaan Berwibawa, tegas, dan mampu mengarahkan karyawan lapangan Memahami penerapan K3 dan penggunaan APD di area bengkel Bahasa Inggris pasif untuk membaca gambar dan spesifikasi teknis menjadi nilai tambah Berdomisili di Batam atau bersedia berpindah ke Batam Bersedia bekerja lembur dan standby untuk pekerjaan mendesak, termasuk pekerjaan in-situ di lokasi customer About us PT. Balindo Citra Perdana berdiri sejak 1998 di Batam, bergerak di bidang fabrikasi, precision machining, welding, serta perbaikan komponen presisi, termasuk shaft, propeller, engine block, cylinder head, dan crankshaft. Kami melayani industri marine, oil & gas, mining, otomotif, dan industri umum di Batam dan sekitarnya.

jobs.title: HOSTESS/WAITRESS
jobs.description: About the role As a Hostess at Indus Restaurant, you will be responsible for warmly welcoming and assisting guests while ensuring a smooth dining experience. The role also supports the service team during busy periods, including taking orders, serving food and beverages, clearing tables, and assisting with daily restaurant operations. Key responsibilities Welcome and greet guests warmly upon arrival Manage guest seating and assist with table arrangements Handle guest inquiries and provide information about the restaurant Coordinate with the service team to ensure smooth guest flow Assist the service team during busy hours when needed Support taking orders, serving food and beverages, clearing tables, and other service duties Maintain a welcoming and professional atmosphere for guests Perform other duties related to restaurant operations as assigned About you Previous experience in restaurant service or as a Hostess is preferred Candidates with a service background are highly preferred as the position will also assist the service team Friendly, confident, and well-groomed Good communication and interpersonal skills Able to work well under pressure and in a fast-paced environment Responsible, proactive, and a good team player Willing to work in shifts About us Casa Luna Group is a hospitality group in Ubud, Bali, encompassing Casa Luna Restaurant, Indus Restaurant, and Honeymoon Guesthouse, including Honeymoon Kitchen and Honeymoon Bakery. About the role

As a Hostess at Indus Restaurant, you will be responsible for warmly welcoming and assisting guests while ensuring a smooth dining experience. The role also supports the service team during busy periods, including taking orders, serving food and beverages, clearing tables, and assisting with daily restaurant operations.

Key responsibilities

  • Welcome and greet guests warmly upon arrival

  • Manage guest seating and assist with table arrangements

  • Handle guest inquiries and provide information about the restaurant

  • Coordinate with the service team to ensure smooth guest flow

  • Assist the service team during busy hours when needed

  • Support taking orders, serving food and beverages, clearing tables, and other service duties

  • Maintain a welcoming and professional atmosphere for guests

  • Perform other duties related to restaurant operations as assigned

About you

  • Previous experience in restaurant service or as a Hostess is preferred

  • Candidates with a service background are highly preferred as the position will also assist the service team

  • Friendly, confident, and well-groomed

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Able to work well under pressure and in a fast-paced environment

  • Responsible, proactive, and a good team player

  • Willing to work in shifts

About us

Casa Luna Group is a hospitality group in Ubud, Bali, encompassing Casa Luna Restaurant, Indus Restaurant, and Honeymoon Guesthouse, including Honeymoon Kitchen and Honeymoon Bakery. The group is dedicated to delivering authentic hospitality experiences while celebrating and preserving Balinese culture, traditions, and community values.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description: Masuk ke Indonesia pada tahun 1993, Air Liquide Indonesia (ALINDO) dan 170 karyawannya telah melayani lebih dari 1000 pelanggan di berbagai industri. Kami mengoperasikan fasilitas produksi gas dan jaringan pipa terbesar untuk Oksigen, Nitrogen, Argon, dan Hidrogen. Infrastruktur tersebut melayani industri baja, petrokimia, dan manufaktur di Jawa Barat - Cilegon-Anyer- Merak, Cibitung, Bojonegara - dan Lampung, Sumatera. Karyawan kami dikembangkan melalui lingkungan kerja yang berkelanjutan dan beragam, bekerja dalam kolaborasi menuju inovasi, efisiensi dan keandalan, untuk memenuhi setiap kebutuhan pelanggan kami. Apa pun yang ingin dicapai karyawan kami, di Air Liquide Indonesia, karyawan selalu didukung dan didorong untuk menjadi yang terbaik. Leverage technical engineering expertise and project management methodologies to plan, oversee the end-to-end execution of complex projects, ensuring strict adherence to safety, quality, and sustainability standards throughout the project lifecycle. Bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi dan berkembang disini? Collaborate with project managers and stakeholders to define project objectives, scope, and requirements and developing detailed project plans and schedules Lead or participate in the design and engineering phases of the project, including creating technical drawings, specifications, and calculations Apply engineering knowledge and expertise to solve complex technical challenges and ensure the project's technical aspects meet industry standards and regulations Identify and assess project risks, develop risk mitigation strategies, and monitor risk factors throughout the project lifecycle Monitor project costs and expenditures to ensure that the project remains within budget and take corrective actions as needed Maintain accurate project documentation, including technical specifications, progress reports, and change orders, and providing regular updates to stakeholders Apakah Anda sesuai? Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in project management within industrial environments. Demonstrated proficiency with industry-standard project management software tools. Ability to provide onsite project support to teams located across various locations. #LI-SP1 **We thank you for your interest in Air Liquide. Interested applicants are encouraged to send in a detailed resume, including reasons for leaving for past employment. Please be informed that only shortlisted candidates would be notified.** Tentang Air Liquide Sebagai pemimpin dunia dalam gas, teknologi dan pelayanan untuk Industri dan Medis, Air Liquide hadir di 78 negara dengan sekitar 64.500 karyawan dan melayani lebih dari 3,8 juta pelanggan dan pasien. Oksigen, nitrogen, dan hidrogen adalah senyawa dasar yang sangat penting untuk kehidupan, energi, dan materi. Senyawa tersebut telah menjadi wujud keahlian Air Liquide dan inti dari operasional perusahaan sejak didirikan pada tahun 1902. Perbedaan membuat performa Di Air Liquide, kami berkomitmen untuk membangun tempat kerja yang beragam dan inklusif yang merangkul keragaman karyawan kami, pelanggan kami, pasien, masyarakat, dan budaya di seluruh dunia. Kami menyambut dan mempertimbangkan aplikasi dari semua pelamar yang memenuhi syarat, terlepas dari latar belakang mereka. Kami sangat percaya bahwa organisasi yang beragam membuka peluang bagi semua karyawan untuk mengekspresikan bakat mereka, baik secara individu maupun kolektif dan membantu mendorong kemampuan untuk berinovasi dengan menjalankan nilai utama kami, bertindak untuk kesuksesan, dan menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang menarik di dunia yang terus berubah.

Job Description

  • Mengelola dan memastikan kelancaran operasional Coffee Bar di bawah arahan Store Manager dan Supervisor
  • Bertanggung jawab atas seluruh proses persiapan minuman di bar, termasuk pelaksanaan tugas harian dan mingguan seperti pembuatan jus dan sirup, mise en place, pembersihan dan perawatan area kerja, pelaporan, pemesanan stok bar, pelabelan, serta pengawasan tanggal kedaluwarsa produk
  • Memastikan seluruh barang dan produk yang mudah rusak di area kerja dikelola dengan baik, termasuk pengendalian dan pemesanan stok

  • Memberikan rekomendasi produk serta menyarankan pairing kopi dengan makanan sesuai preferensi tamu
  • Memberikan pelayanan pelanggan yang prima dengan orientasi pada kepuasan dan pengalaman tamu

Job Requirements

  • Pendidikan SMA/SMK, Diploma, atau Strata dari jurusan Tata Boga, Perhotelan, atau bidang terkait
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja kurang dari 1 tahun di posisi yang sama
  • Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur nasional
  • Memahami dasar pembuatan kopi serta minuman berbasis espresso dan manual brew
  • Mampu mengoperasikan peralatan bar serta menjaga standar kebersihan area kerja
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan berorientasi pada pelayanan pelanggan
  • Teliti, cekatan, dan mampu bekerja dalam lingkungan operasional yang cepat
  • Memiliki minat dan ketertarikan tinggi terhadap dunia kopi dan layanan Food & Beverage

Job Description

  • Memberikan layanan kepada tamu secara konsisten sesuai dengan standar kualitas dan pelayanan perusahaan
  • Menyambut, mengarahkan, dan melayani tamu dengan sikap profesional untuk menciptakan pengalaman bersantap yang positif
  • Menyampaikan informasi menu, promosi, serta rekomendasi produk secara jelas dan akurat kepada tamu
  • Memastikan pencatatan dan penyampaian pesanan dilakukan secara tepat dan efisien kepada departemen terkait
  • Menyajikan makanan dan minuman sesuai dengan standar operasional, kualitas, dan waktu pelayanan yang telah ditetapkan
  • Memantau tingkat kepuasan tamu selama proses pelayanan serta melakukan tindak lanjut yang diperlukan
  • Menangani pertanyaan dan keluhan tamu secara profesional, serta melakukan eskalasi sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku
  • Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan, dan kesiapan area pelayanan sesuai dengan standar kebersihan dan higiene perusahaan
  • Melaksanakan prosedur operasional pembukaan dan penutupan (opening & closing) outlet sesuai ketentuan
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim operasional untuk memastikan kelancaran dan kualitas pelayanan
  • Memastikan keakuratan transaksi dan tagihan sebelum disampaikan kepada tamu
  • Mematuhi seluruh kebijakan perusahaan, Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP), serta standar keselamatan dan kebersihan kerja

Job Requirements

  • Pendidikan SMA/SMK, Diploma, atau Strata dari jurusan Tata Boga, Perhotelan, atau bidang terkait
  • Memiliki pengalaman 1 tahun di posisi yang sama
  • Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur nasional
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan orientasi tinggi pada kepuasan pelanggan
  • Berpenampilan rapi dan profesional, serta memiliki sikap kerja yang positif
  • Mampu bekerja secara tim dalam lingkungan kerja yang dinamis
  • Memiliki ketahanan fisik yang baik untuk bekerja selama jam operasional restoran

jobs.title: Store Leader Pontianak (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Create a sales strategy and work plan to achieve sales targets. Implement and monitor SOP compliance of recruitment, training development, promotional, finance, stock, and operation to ensure the store complies with the policy. Analyze needs and provide support to improve store effective & efficient store management systems. Monitor and control store operational excellence to ensure that day-to-day operational activity supports the achievement of store goals. Analyze, monitor, and evaluate store performance in predetermined areas to ensure the achievement of targets and operational standards of procedures, and to help overcome problems in store. Monitor and develop staff in the predetermined areas to build a leadership succession plan in store Job Requirements 1-3 years of working experience in the fashion retail industry, preferably experience as an Assistant Store Manager/ Store Manager/ Store Head/ Store Leader Familiar with ATV, UPT, Conversion Rate, breakdown of the target, analyzing by week and month Possess good customer service, drive to achieve sales targets, strong leadership, & hard work. Have a good interpersonal skill, good in problem-solving, & good in communication. Willing to work in shifts (including weekends) Ready to work 6 days in a week Willing to be placed in Pontianak (West Kalimantan)

jobs.title: HCBP Assistant Manager (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Collaborate with business leaders to understand organizational goals and align human capital strategies to support business objectives. Develop and implement HR initiatives that enhance employee engagement, workforce planning, and overall organizational effectiveness. Continuously monitor and analyze key OHI metrics, including talent mapping, workforce fulfillment, turnover trends, organizational development, learning journeys, competency fitness, and equity. Drive career development programs, succession planning, and talent reviews to strengthen leadership pipelines and business continuity. Work as a strategic advisor to business units by providing insights and recommendations on people-related matters. Partner with learning and development teams to create targeted training initiatives that drive individual and organizational growth. Job Requirements Bachelor degree from psychology, management, or equivalent 3-5 years of experience as an HRBP in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Ability to analyze workforce data and translate insights into business strategies. Strong understanding of HR best practices, workforce planning, and talent management. Capable of engaging and partnering with senior stakeholders. Experience in fostering positive workplace culture and handling complex HR matters. Ability to implement HR initiatives that drive organizational success. Strong ability to communicate with regional teams and business leaders. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, high-pressure retail environment.

4. Willing to work in shift (including weekend)

5. Ready to work 6 days in a week

6. Willing to be placed in South Sulawesi

jobs.title: Learning Partner Supervisor Medan (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Collaborate with business partners to identify organizational and individual training needs. Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) to align learning priorities with business objectives. Facilitate training programs for both operational and head office employees. Design and develop training materials, syllabi, and curriculum tailored to organizational requirements. Execute on-the-job training and field observations to reinforce knowledge application. Evaluate training effectiveness up to Level 3 (behavioral change) to ensure measurable impact. Drive talent development initiatives to build a strong internal pipeline of future leaders. Job Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in any major. Minimum 3 years of experience as a Trainer; exposure to Gadget, Electronics, or Fashion industries is an advantage. Strong analytical skills to measure training effectiveness. Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Canva. Strong knowledge of iOS and Android operating systems or gadget Freak will be advantage. Highly communicative, proactive, and dependable with strong initiative. Adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic business environment. Willing to travel and conduct mobile training sessions. Fluent in English, both spoken and written. Based in Medan

jobs.title: Data Analyst & Monitoring Makassar (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Job Description 1. Perform target setting for value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales (distribution channel) 2. Setting sales targets per BU, by store by category (retail channel) 3. Monitoring the achievement of target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales. 4. Conduct an analysis of productivity in achieving target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand by depot by sales and create a proposal plan for improvement. 5. Monitoring the productivity of dealers (both new dealers and existing dealers) 6. Conduct monitoring and analysis of sales achievements per Business Unit, by store by category. 7. Conduct an analysis of the profitability of stores in each channel, whether multibrand, monobrand, or joint business, to create a development plan. 8. Providing the required reports for the business, whether daily, weekly, or monthly reports, which will be used by the sales team in planning. 9. Creating a visual report or dashboard related to sales data and customers 10. Conducting an analysis of customer dynamics to provide business improvement proposals to be implemented in retail or distribution channels. 11. To develop and propose a project improvement in reporting Job Requirements Job Requirements 1. Educational background in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field are welcomed to apply 2. 1–2 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Monitoring Officer, or in a related analytical role. 3. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and basic data analysis. 4. Capable of visualizing data and turning insights into clear, engaging presentations. 5. Experienced in using Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint, or similar tools for creating reports and visual storytelling. 6. Able to use data tools such as SQL, Power BI, or Tableau is a must 7. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills. 8. Strong communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, including written and verbal. 9. Willing to work fully from office in Makassar (South Sulawesi)

Job Description

Job Description

1. Perform target setting for value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales (distribution channel)

2. Setting sales targets per BU, by store by category (retail channel)

3. Monitoring the achievement of target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand, by depot, by sales.

4. Conduct an analysis of productivity in achieving target value, BO (Bill Outlet), QVO (Quality Value Outlet) by brand by depot by sales and create a proposal plan for improvement.

5. Monitoring the productivity of dealers (both new dealers and existing dealers)

6. Conduct monitoring and analysis of sales achievements per Business Unit, by store by category.

7. Conduct an analysis of the profitability of stores in each channel, whether multibrand, monobrand, or joint business, to create a development plan.

8. Providing the required reports for the business, whether daily, weekly, or monthly reports, which will be used by the sales team in planning.

9. Creating a visual report or dashboard related to sales data and customers

10. Conducting an analysis of customer dynamics to provide business improvement proposals to be implemented in retail or distribution channels.

11. To develop and propose a project improvement in reporting

Job Requirements

Job Requirements

1. Educational background in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field are welcomed to apply

2. 1–2 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Monitoring Officer, or in a related analytical role.

3. Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, pivot tables, and basic data analysis.

4. Capable of visualizing data and turning insights into clear, engaging presentations.

5. Experienced in using Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint, or similar tools for creating reports and visual storytelling.

6. Able to use data tools such as SQL, Power BI, or Tableau is a must

7. Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

8. Strong communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, including written and verbal.

9. Willing to work fully from office in Makassar (South Sulawesi)

jobs.title: Sr. IT Business Analyst (Talent Pool)
jobs.description: Job Description Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document both functional and non-functional requirements. Review existing business processes, identify gaps, and recommend system improvements to enhance efficiency and performance. Work closely with IT teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before deployment. Act as a liaison between business units and IT, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables. Lead and coordinate business analysis activities across projects, ensuring timely and successful implementation. Job Requirements Educational background in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields. Minimum 5 years of experience as a System Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Business Analyst, preferably in a technology-driven environment. Experience in ERP, B2C POS, Supply Chain Management (SCM), or Logistics modules. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with hands-on experience in documentation and process mapping. Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Asana. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

Job Description

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document both functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Review existing business processes, identify gaps, and recommend system improvements to enhance efficiency and performance.
  • Work closely with IT teams to ensure solutions meet business needs and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before deployment.
  • Act as a liaison between business units and IT, ensuring clear communication and alignment on project goals, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Lead and coordinate business analysis activities across projects, ensuring timely and successful implementation.

Job Requirements

  • Educational background in Information Technology, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a System Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Business Analyst, preferably in a technology-driven environment.
  • Experience in ERP, B2C POS, Supply Chain Management (SCM), or Logistics modules.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills with hands-on experience in documentation and process mapping.
  • Familiar with the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and project collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Asana.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to manage stakeholder expectations and work effectively in cross-functional teams.

jobs.description: Job Description Supervise and lead store staff in daily operations, including cashiering, food preparation, and customer service areas. Ensure all operational procedures and brand standards are followed, including cleanliness, food safety, service quality, and product presentation. Assist with scheduling and workforce planning to maintain optimal staffing levels. Provide basic training and coaching for team members, and address any team-related issues in real-time. Support inventory control, stock ordering, and waste management processes. Handle customer feedback and complaints in a professional and timely manner. Work toward achieving sales targets and operational efficiency goals. Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, inventory, and store performance. Foster positive communication and teamwork among staff and management. Job Requirements Minimum high school diploma; diploma or degree in hospitality, culinary arts, or business management is a plus. At least 2 years of experience in food & beverage retail or the quick-service restaurant industry, with prior supervisory experience preferred. Strong leadership and team motivation skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, including weekends and holidays. High level of discipline, attention to detail, and multitasking ability. Knowledge of inventory management, quality control, and customer service principles.

jobs.description: Job Description Strategic Marketing Planning Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies to support business growth and brand positioning. Analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitor activities to identify opportunities and challenges. Collaborate with the leadership team to set marketing goals and KPIs. Brand Management Ensure consistent brand messaging and visual identity across all customer touchpoints. Plan and execute campaigns to build and enhance brand equity. Monitor brand performance and implement improvements based on feedback and analytics. Digital Marketing and Social Media Oversee the digital marketing strategy, including SEO, SEM, email campaigns, and social media management. Develop engaging content to increase online presence and follower growth on key platforms. Analyze digital performance metrics and optimize campaigns for maximum ROI. Campaign Management Plan and execute marketing campaigns for new product launches, seasonal promotions, and events. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, sales, and R&D) to ensure seamless campaign execution. Monitor campaign performance and recommend adjustments for continuous improvement. Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Develop and manage loyalty programs to drive repeat purchases and customer retention. Utilize CRM tools to analyze customer data and deliver personalized marketing initiatives. Collect and act on customer feedback to improve marketing strategies and customer satisfaction. Partnerships and Collaborations Identify and establish partnerships with influencers, media, and complementary brands. Negotiate sponsorships and collaborations to maximize brand exposure. Manage relationships with external vendors, including agencies and suppliers. Budgeting and Reporting Prepare and manage the marketing budget, ensuring efficient use of resources. Track and report on marketing campaign performance, including ROI and other KPIs. Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders based on data analysis. Job Requirements Minimum 5-7 years of experience in marketing, preferably in retail. Proven track record in developing and executing successful marketing campaigns. Strong understanding of the Indonesian market and consumer behavior. Expertise in digital marketing tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Meta Ads). Proficiency in CRM and loyalty program management. Excellent project management and organizational skills. Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Languages: Proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

Analyze working drawings, technical specifications, and tender documents to develop accurate cost calculations. Compare and evaluate price proposals from contractors and vendors. Prepare the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) from the owner’s perspective. Coordinate with design, engineering, procurement, and project management teams for cost validation. Ensure that all cost estimates comply with the company’s budgeting standards and policies. Provide cost analysis reports and recommendations to management. Job Requirements Education: Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Interior Design or Architecture Work Experience: Minimum of 5–7 years of experience in retail store construction, specifically in the role of Interior Designer Language: Indonesian and English

jobs.description: Job Description Ensure compliance with customs and import regulations, including document validation and coordination with PPJK. Manage freight and logistics operations, including shipment planning and execution from origin warehouses to Indonesia (Air & Sea Freight). Oversee and monitor inbound supply chain activities, ensuring minimal disruption to production and distribution schedules. Utilize SAP/ERP systems for logistics, inventory tracking, and reporting. Develop and maintain strong vendor relationships, including forwarders, suppliers, and third-party logistics providers. Coordinate with internal stakeholders such as Accounting, Tax, and Finance teams to ensure accurate and timely documentation. Prepare, review, and control all import-related documents to support smooth clearance and compliance processes. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, International Business, or related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in import, logistics, or supply chain operations. Strong knowledge of customs procedures, import regulations, and international trade compliance (customs certification is a plus). Experience managing air and sea freight shipments. Hands-on proficiency in SAP/ERP systems. Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple stakeholders simultaneously. Fluency in English (spoken and written).

Strong leadership skills with the ability to train, guide, and motivate operational teams.

About the role

Sales administration role involving order management, document creation, customer coordination, and administrative support across sales, production, warehouse, and accounting functions.

Key responsibilities

  1. Input and manage customer orders

  2. Create quotations, sales orders, invoices, and sales documents

  3. Follow up on orders and delivery schedules with customers

  4. Coordinate with Sales, Production, Warehouse, and Accounting departments

  5. Answer customer inquiries via WhatsApp, telephone, or email

  6. Create sales reports and administrative reports on a regular basis

  7. Ensure customer data and transaction records are properly stored

About you

  • Minimum education: SMA/SMK; D3/S1 preferred

  • Minimum 1 year experience as Sales Admin or in Administration

  • Experience in plastic packaging manufacturing

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

  • Detail-oriented, organized, communicative, and responsible

  • Able to work with targets and deadlines

  • Able to work collaboratively with a team

  • Experience in manufacturing companies is an added value

Benefits

  • Salary according to experience and ability

  • Health and Employment BPJS

jobs.title: Inventory & PPIC Staff – Printing & Packaging
jobs.description: Integras adalah perusahaan percetakan offset dan kemasan yang sedang berkembang. Kami memproduksi berbagai solusi kemasan berbahan kertas, seperti folding box, paper bag, paper packaging, dan corrugated box untuk pelanggan dari berbagai industri. Kami mencari Inventory & PPIC Staff yang teliti dan terorganisir untuk menjaga akurasi persediaan, kelengkapan transaksi barang, serta ketertiban administrasi warehouse dan PPIC. TANGGUNG JAWAB UTAMA • Memantau persediaan bahan baku, WIP, dan barang jadi. • Mencatat penerimaan, pemakaian, perpindahan, dan pengeluaran barang. • Memastikan transaksi barang tercatat secara akurat dan tepat waktu. • Memeriksa kesesuaian stok fisik dengan data sistem. • Melaksanakan stock opname secara berkala. • Menelusuri dan melaporkan penyebab selisih stok. • Menjaga penataan, identifikasi, dan ketertelusuran barang. • Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen keluar-masuk barang. • Menyiapkan laporan inventory secara harian dan berkala. • Memantau kesiapan material berdasarkan kebutuhan produksi. • Membantu memperbarui data kebutuhan dan jadwal produksi. KUALIFIKASI WAJIB • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Manajemen, Logistik, Teknik Industri, atau bidang terkait. • Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang inventory, warehouse, atau PPIC. • Memahami administrasi persediaan dan alur keluar-masuk barang. • Memahami stock opname dan rekonsiliasi selisih stok. • Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk pengolahan dan pelaporan data. • Teliti, disiplin, dan terbiasa bekerja dengan data serta dokumen. • Bersedia bekerja penuh waktu secara onsite. LOKASI DAN JAM KERJA Jakarta Purnawaktu · Onsite

Integras adalah perusahaan percetakan offset dan kemasan yang sedang berkembang. Kami memproduksi berbagai solusi kemasan berbahan kertas, seperti folding box, paper bag, paper packaging, dan corrugated box untuk pelanggan dari berbagai industri.

Kami mencari Inventory & PPIC Staff yang teliti dan terorganisir untuk menjaga akurasi persediaan, kelengkapan transaksi barang, serta ketertiban administrasi warehouse dan PPIC.

TANGGUNG JAWAB UTAMA

• Memantau persediaan bahan baku, WIP, dan barang jadi.

• Mencatat penerimaan, pemakaian, perpindahan, dan pengeluaran barang.

• Memastikan transaksi barang tercatat secara akurat dan tepat waktu.

• Memeriksa kesesuaian stok fisik dengan data sistem.

• Melaksanakan stock opname secara berkala.

• Menelusuri dan melaporkan penyebab selisih stok.

• Menjaga penataan, identifikasi, dan ketertelusuran barang.

• Memastikan kelengkapan dokumen keluar-masuk barang.

• Menyiapkan laporan inventory secara harian dan berkala.

• Memantau kesiapan material berdasarkan kebutuhan produksi.

• Membantu memperbarui data kebutuhan dan jadwal produksi.

KUALIFIKASI WAJIB

• Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Manajemen, Logistik, Teknik Industri, atau bidang terkait.

• Pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang inventory, warehouse, atau PPIC.

• Memahami administrasi persediaan dan alur keluar-masuk barang.

• Memahami stock opname dan rekonsiliasi selisih stok.

• Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Excel untuk pengolahan dan pelaporan data.

• Teliti, disiplin, dan terbiasa bekerja dengan data serta dokumen.

• Bersedia bekerja penuh waktu secara onsite.

LOKASI DAN JAM KERJA

Jakarta

Purnawaktu · Onsite

jobs.title: Senior Finance Executive
jobs.description: About the role Responsible for managing the full set of accounts for PT Jemco Manufacturing Indonesia, including financial reporting, month-end closing, inventory/costing and statutory compliance. The role requires an accounting professional with strong knowledge of accounting standards and Indonesian local authority requirements. As a newly established manufacturing company, the role will also support the setup of accounting processes and controls. What you will do: Manage the full set of accounts, including GL, AP, AR, cash/bank, fixed assets and month-end closing. Establish and maintain proper accounting processes, procedures and internal controls for the newly established company. Prepare monthly financial statements, management reports and supporting schedules. Perform bank, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations. Manage month-end and year-end closing activities accurately and within deadlines. Handle accounting for raw materials, WIP and finished goods. Support manufacturing costing, production cost analysis and inventory reconciliation. Monitor inventory movements and investigate stock/cost variances. Support physical stock counts and ensure appropriate accounting treatment of inventory adjustments. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and applicable local statutory requirements. What you need to have: Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance or a related field. 3 to 5 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably with full-set accounting exposure. Prior experience in a manufacturing company is strongly preferred. Strong understanding of accounting standards and local Indonesian statutory requirements. Good knowledge of Indonesian taxation and compliance requirements. Practical experience in inventory accounting and manufacturing costing. Experience dealing with auditors, tax consultants and/or Indonesian authorities. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and ERP/SAP systems. Experience with SAP Business One or other ERP systems is an advantage. Good command of Bahasa Indonesia and English.

About the role

Responsible for managing the full set of accounts for PT Jemco Manufacturing Indonesia, including financial reporting, month-end closing, inventory/costing and statutory compliance. The role requires an accounting professional with strong knowledge of accounting standards and Indonesian local authority requirements. As a newly established manufacturing company, the role will also support the setup of accounting processes and controls.

What you will do:

  • Manage the full set of accounts, including GL, AP, AR, cash/bank, fixed assets and month-end closing.

  • Establish and maintain proper accounting processes, procedures and internal controls for the newly established company.

  • Prepare monthly financial statements, management reports and supporting schedules.

  • Perform bank, balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations.

  • Manage month-end and year-end closing activities accurately and within deadlines.

  • Handle accounting for raw materials, WIP and finished goods.

  • Support manufacturing costing, production cost analysis and inventory reconciliation.

  • Monitor inventory movements and investigate stock/cost variances.

  • Support physical stock counts and ensure appropriate accounting treatment of inventory adjustments.

  • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and applicable local statutory requirements.

What you need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance or a related field.

  • 3 to 5 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably with full-set accounting exposure.

  • Prior experience in a manufacturing company is strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of accounting standards and local Indonesian statutory requirements.

  • Good knowledge of Indonesian taxation and compliance requirements.

  • Practical experience in inventory accounting and manufacturing costing.

  • Experience dealing with auditors, tax consultants and/or Indonesian authorities.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and ERP/SAP systems.

  • Experience with SAP Business One or other ERP systems is an advantage.

  • Good command of Bahasa Indonesia and English.

About the role

Teknisi Pemeliharaan bertanggung jawab merawat sekitar 50 sistem rainwater harvesting yang terpasang di sekolah-sekolah. Pekerjaan ini meliputi kunjungan rutin bulanan ke lokasi, perawatan berkala, pencarian dan perbaikan kerusakan, serta pelaporan data secara tepat waktu. Sebagian besar waktu kerja dihabiskan di lapangan, bukan di kantor.

Key responsibilities

  • Merawat dan mengawasi sekitar 50 sistem rainwater harvesting di sekolah-sekolah

  • Melakukan kunjungan rutin bulanan ke setiap lokasi untuk perawatan berkala, termasuk mengganti filter dan lampu UV

  • Mengikuti checklist perawatan standar di setiap kunjungan

  • Mengisi Survei Monitoring Bulanan dengan data yang akurat

  • Memberikan pelatihan singkat/penyegaran kepada staf sekolah tentang cara mengoperasikan sistem, bila diperlukan

  • Mencari penyebab dan memperbaiki masalah teknis agar semua sistem tetap berfungsi (online)

  • Membeli material atau spare part kecil untuk perbaikan bila diperlukan

  • Membuat laporan pekerjaan dan pengeluaran yang sudah diselesaikan

  • Membantu tugas administratif sederhana lainnya sesuai kebutuhan

About you

  • Pendidikan minimum SMK Teknik /D1 Teknik, jurusan yang relevan, diutamakan yang berpengalaman

  • Menguasai keterampilan dasar kelistrikan dan perpipaan air (plumbing sederhana)

  • Bisa mengoperasikan komputer/HP untuk keperluan kerja dasar (input data, membuat laporan, dll)

  • Lancar berbahasa Indonesia (berbicara, membaca, menulis)

  • Bertanggung jawab tinggi dan teliti dalam bekerja

  • Bersedia sering bepergian ke lokasi sekolah dan desa; memiliki SIM (diutamakan punya kendaraan sendiri)

  • Bersedia mengikuti training untuk memahami sistem rainwater harvesting dan sistem air minum di sekolah

  • Diutamakan berdomisili di Karawang

About us

PT Cloudwell Water Technologies adalah social enterprise yang mengubah air hujan menjadi air bersih siap pakai untuk sekolah-sekolah yang membutuhkan. Anda akan bergabung dengan tim yang solid dan memiliki misi jelas: membangun ketahanan air dan iklim untuk sekolah dan masyarakat.

Benefits

About the role

Export Marketing & Commodity Sourcing Specialist responsible for identifying and developing new international buyers while sourcing suppliers and products in Indonesia. The role involves prospecting, negotiation, and managing export transactions across commodities including charcoal briquette, coffee, coconut products, spices, and agricultural products.

Key responsibilities

  • Search for and develop new buyers and customers from abroad

  • Conduct prospecting through LinkedIn, Google, B2B marketplace, trade database, email, and other channels

  • Communicate, follow-up, provide quotations and negotiate with buyers until closing

  • Analyse countries and potential markets for various commodities

  • Source suppliers and producers in Indonesia according to buyer requirements

  • Compare supplier pricing, quality, specifications, MOQ and capacity

  • Understand export transaction processes from inquiry to shipment

  • Handle and coordinate documents, permits, freight forwarders and export processes

  • Assist in calculating costing, selling price and margins for export transactions

About you

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Export Sales, Export Marketing, International Trade or Commodity Trading

  • Must have experience sourcing foreign buyers

  • Active English language capability, especially for business communication and negotiation

  • Understanding of Incoterms (FOB, CFR/CNF, CIF, EXW) and international payment methods such as TT and LC

  • Understanding of basic export documents and procedures

  • Strong sales, negotiation and closing capabilities

  • Able to source and negotiate with suppliers

  • Proactive, target-oriented with strong problem-solving capabilities

  • Willing to undertake business travel to suppliers and factories if required

jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description: Background We’re Y24/7 (read: your twenty-four seven) A creative digital agency built to make things actually work. Not just look good, but land, perform, and drive real results. From big campaign ideas to daily content, from KOL to offline activations, we build work that connects, performs, and actually matters to the business. Our clients range from FMCG to startups and tech companies. Good work. Healthy culture. Real impact. We are now hiring Associate Creative Director to be part of our amazing Creative and Design team: Responsibilities 1. Responsible for the creative direction, quality control, production supervision, and improvement of the Company’s creative working processes. 2. Continue the creative direction and supervise the production process for Brand Campaigns including: PPM 2 and final production alignment Shooting/production supervision Offline editing review Online editing review Sound mixing review Final master review Final derivative assets review Final delivery KOL big idea development. 3. Ensure that the agreed creative intent is consistently translated from the PPM stage through final delivery, while considering the agreed creative quality, timeline, and production budget 4. Provide creative direction and/or develop creative ideas for other campaign requirements during the engagement period, including Creative ideation and development Big idea / communication idea Video concept and storyline Script and treatment review Production supervision Offline and online review Sound mixing Final delivery. 5. Assist the Company in the implementation and improvement of SOPs and workflows for creative quality control, including: Evaluating the existing creative workflow Assisting in implementing the maker-checker system and creative QC process Establishing creative review checkpoints before materials are presented to the client Providing workflow improvement recommendations to minimize QC gaps and unnecessary revisions Improving alignment among the Account Team, Creative Team, Production House/vendor, and client Helping establish creative output quality standards that can be applied by the Creative Team Providing coaching and feedback to the Creative Team to improve the quality of ideas and execution General Scope= − Conceptualize the creative communication campaign, or digital creative campaign, including produce extraordinary key visual, engaging video content and storyboard for digital marketing campaigns, social media platforms, product launches, and corporate communications. - Collaborate closely with the account & strategy team to understand project goals, target audience and brand guideline to create videos that unique ideas, exceptional visual concept, and yet resonates with client’s target audience, as well as supporting the other stakeholders. − Stay up-to-date on industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies in video production and digital marketing to continuously improve video content strategy. − Create engaging visuals and conceptual visuals; Design graphics and visuals (both static & motion). − Use a wide range of visual production hardware and software (including photography equipment and Adobe Creative Suite) to produce high-impact, on-brand designs. − Optimize videos for different platforms and formats, ensuring maximum engagement and reach. − Utilize video editing software to edit footage, add effects, graphics, and animations, ensuring high-quality output that meets brand standard. − Copywriting skill ability to create and assess captions and storylines -Must have the capability to lead the team, delegate tasks effectively, and coach team members to develop stronger creative thinking skills , while demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and responsibility for projects, consistently delivering beyond client expectations . Qualifications − Bachelor’s degree in Visual Communication Design, Animation, Fine Art, Advertising or related fields and had experience in a creative agency. − Minimum of 5 years as Creative Lead and handle creative team, handle video designer, video editor or similar role with a strong portfolio showcasing creative and impactful video content − Proficiency in digital platform creative requirements (e.g. instagram, tiktok, website, facebook, and others) − Excellent working knowledge of design software, particularly Adobe programs, Final Cut Pro, etc. − Creative mindset with a keen eye for visual storytelling and attention to detail. − Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects and deadlines. − Ability to interpreting translate marketing objectives into compelling visual narratives.

jobs.title: Sustainable Food Sales Manager (Indonesia)
jobs.description: Company Description Calling all ambitious, personable deal makers who want a job with meaning! Want a full-time job working from home (some travel required) at a job that makes the world a better place? Set your own full-time hours, with room for growth, a competitive salary, and a results-driven atmosphere. This is a great job for resourceful, influential, and self-directed people who are highly skilled at interpersonal negotiation and sales, who are bold and resilient, and who want to do work that makes an impactful difference. Must be fluent in Indonesian and conversational or fluent in English. Lever Foundation is a global non-profit that focuses on creating a more humane and sustainable protein supply chain in Asia and beyond. We work with large food companies and suppliers to secure commitments to more sustainable and higher-welfare practices. Our partners include leading food and beverage companies such as SuperIndo, Swiss BelHotel, Burger King, Marriott, Ranch Market, and many others. In recent years, in response to increasing concern for sustainability and animal welfare, hundreds of food companies operating in Asia have set corporate policies to source only “cage-free” eggs, which are far more humane for animals and much higher in food safety. Lever Foundation has helped secure policies on this topic and other food sustainability topics, such as sustainable protein and plant-based foods, from over 250 companies in Asia and beyond. You can learn more about Lever at: https://www.leverfoundation.org Job Description As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will proactively reach out and build relationships with decision-makers at leading food companies across the country. You will help educate these companies on the environmental, animal welfare, and economic benefits of implementing stronger sustainable food sourcing policies, such as the use of cage-free eggs, in their supply chain. You will provide industry updates, connect these companies with potential suppliers, and provide other resources to help them understand and set targets on the issue. In order to identify and engage with top management of the new food companies, you will actively network and outreach by doing online research, writing and sending emails, making calls, and conducting visits and meetings with companies. You get the benefits of working from home with flexible hours, and you’ll have wonderful colleagues in Indonesia and across the region to work with you and support you. Through this work, you will have hands-on experience working with leading food companies on corporate sustainability, with room for advancement to managerial or other positions. Qualifications We do not require any particular educational or work background, although prior experience in sales, negotiation, business development, or similar sales- or advocacy-style work is a very strong plus. We're looking for an aspiring candidate with the following personality traits and skills needed to succeed in this job: Extroverted and proactive in building relationships and personal networks Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and be highly engaging and persuasive Ability to work independently, with a very strong work ethic and a can-do mentality Ability to remain resilient and motivated when you are brushed off Personal interest in sustainability, animal welfare, or public Health Must be fluent in Indonesian and conversational or fluent in English

Company Description

Calling all ambitious, personable deal makers who want a job with meaning! Want a full-time job working from home (some travel required) at a job that makes the world a better place? Set your own full-time hours, with room for growth, a competitive salary, and a results-driven atmosphere. This is a great job for resourceful, influential, and self-directed people who are highly skilled at interpersonal negotiation and sales, who are bold and resilient, and who want to do work that makes an impactful difference. Must be fluent in Indonesian and conversational or fluent in English.

Lever Foundation is a global non-profit that focuses on creating a more humane and sustainable protein supply chain in Asia and beyond. We work with large food companies and suppliers to secure commitments to more sustainable and higher-welfare practices. Our partners include leading food and beverage companies such as SuperIndo, Swiss BelHotel, Burger King, Marriott, Ranch Market, and many others.

In recent years, in response to increasing concern for sustainability and animal welfare, hundreds of food companies operating in Asia have set corporate policies to source only “cage-free” eggs, which are far more humane for animals and much higher in food safety. Lever Foundation has helped secure policies on this topic and other food sustainability topics, such as sustainable protein and plant-based foods, from over 250 companies in Asia and beyond.

You can learn more about Lever at: https://www.leverfoundation.org

Job Description

As a Sustainability Program Manager, you will proactively reach out and build relationships with decision-makers at leading food companies across the country. You will help educate these companies on the environmental, animal welfare, and economic benefits of implementing stronger sustainable food sourcing policies, such as the use of cage-free eggs, in their supply chain. You will provide industry updates, connect these companies with potential suppliers, and provide other resources to help them understand and set targets on the issue. In order to identify and engage with top management of the new food companies, you will actively network and outreach by doing online research, writing and sending emails, making calls, and conducting visits and meetings with companies.

You get the benefits of working from home with flexible hours, and you’ll have wonderful colleagues in Indonesia and across the region to work with you and support you. Through this work, you will have hands-on experience working with leading food companies on corporate sustainability, with room for advancement to managerial or other positions.

Qualifications

We do not require any particular educational or work background, although prior experience in sales, negotiation, business development, or similar sales- or advocacy-style work is a very strong plus.

We're looking for an aspiring candidate with the following personality traits and skills needed to succeed in this job:

  • Extroverted and proactive in building relationships and personal networks

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and be highly engaging and persuasive

  • Ability to work independently, with a very strong work ethic and a can-do mentality

  • Ability to remain resilient and motivated when you are brushed off

  • Personal interest in sustainability, animal welfare, or public Health

  • Must be fluent in Indonesian and conversational or fluent in English

jobs.title: Mekanik Spooring
jobs.description: KK Radial Tyre Shop sebagai bengkel ban mobil, membuka lowongan kerja untuk posisi Mekanik Spooring di Kabupaten Sukabumi, Jawa Barat. Sebagai Mekanik Spooring , Anda akan memainkan peranan penting dalam menjaga kendaraan pelanggan kami tetap selaras dan beroperasi dengan lancar. Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Melakukan pemeriksaan dan penyetelan roda kendaraan untuk memastikan penyelarasan yang tepat. Menganalisis masalah pada sistem kemudi dan suspensi kendaraan, serta melakukan perbaikan yang diperlukan. Menggunakan mesin dan alat ukur spooring 3D untuk menyelesaikan pekerjaan dengan akurat dan efisien. Memberikan saran kepada pelanggan tentang perawatan kendaraan yang tepat untuk mencegah masalah spooring di masa mendatang. Memperbarui catatan kerja dan dokumentasi terkait pekerjaan yang dilakukan. Bekerja dalam tim untuk memastikan kepuasan pelanggan yang optimal. Persyaratan: Lulusan teknik otomotif dengan sertifikasi atau pelatihan yang relevan di bidang mekanik / spooring mobil. Pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Mekanik Spooring atau posisi serupa di bengkel otomotif. Memahami dengan baik sistem kemudi dan suspensi mobil serta mampu melakukan diagnosa dan perbaikan kaki-kaki mobil. Terampil menggunakan peralatan dan alat ukur spooring 3D. Mampu mengendarai mobil matic maupun manual Memiliki keahlian troubleshooting yang baik dan kemampuan komunikasi yang efektif dengan pelanggan. Berkomitmen untuk memberikan pelayanan terbaik dan memastikan kepuasan pelanggan. Tentang kami: KK Radial Tyre Shop berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman servis otomotif terbaik bagi pelanggan kami melalui keahlian tim kami dan penggunaan teknologi canggih. Kami memiliki lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan kolaboratif, fasilitas kerja yang modern dan nyaman, serta kesempatan untuk mengembangkan keterampilan teknis dan profesional.

jobs.title: IoT & Software Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities Mengembangkan dan memelihara backend, server, database, API, dan aplikasi web untuk kebutuhan digitalization project. Mengembangkan dashboard monitoring, reporting, alarm, dan data visualization . Melakukan integrasi data mesin menggunakan MQTT, OPC UA, dan protokol IoT lainnya . Mengembangkan sistem machine monitoring dan industrial IoT . Mengelola database dan data pipeline untuk pengolahan data mesin secara realtime. Mengembangkan dan mengintegrasikan REST API dengan aplikasi dan sistem lainnya. Melakukan deployment dan maintenance aplikasi menggunakan Linux dan Docker . Mengelola version control menggunakan Git . Mendukung konfigurasi dan troubleshooting network untuk kebutuhan sistem automation dan IoT. Menerapkan basic cybersecurity, access control, backup, dan data protection . Melakukan monitoring system, troubleshooting aplikasi, dan memastikan sistem berjalan dengan baik. Membuat dokumentasi aplikasi, database, API, konfigurasi, dan sistem yang dikembangkan. Berkoordinasi dengan tim PLC, Electrical, Mechanical, Engineering, IT, dan departemen terkait dalam pelaksanaan project. Mendukung pengembangan solusi digital untuk machine monitoring, IPAL, IoT, automation, dan improvement lintas departemen . Requirements Pendidikan minimal S1 Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Komputer, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang relevan. Fresh Graduate hingga maksimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Full-stack Developer, IoT Engineer, atau IT Infrastructure Engineer. Menguasai salah satu atau lebih bahasa pemrograman seperti JavaScript/TypeScript atau Python . Memahami PostgreSQL atau MySQL . Memiliki kemampuan membuat atau mengembangkan web dashboard dan data visualization . Memahami REST API, MQTT, OPC UA , atau protokol komunikasi IoT. Memahami dasar Linux, Docker, server, dan deployment . Memahami dasar networking dan cybersecurity . Menguasai penggunaan Git/version control . Memiliki kemampuan analisa dan problem solving yang baik. Memiliki ketertarikan terhadap Industrial IoT, Automation, Data Integration, dan Digitalization . Bersedia bekerja langsung di area pabrik dan melakukan troubleshooting system apabila diperlukan. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
