jobs.title: Procurement Manager - Butter Protein Club - Pererenan
jobs.description: Position : Head of Procurement Client : Butter Protein Club Location : Bali, Indonesia Department : Procurement Reports To : General Manager About Us The Cakap Group (TCG) is a licensed hospitality management and restaurant consulting company in Indonesia with an 11-year history of success. We design, launch, and manage a diverse portfolio of prestigious projects, ranging from boutique hotels and luxury resorts to restaurants and luxury yachts. With over 150 successful projects and 800+ employees recruited, we offer a stable, dynamic, and internationally standardized working environment. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team of specialists, supported by our state-of-the-art Research & Development (R&D) kitchen and modern training facilities in Bali. Join us to accelerate your career and be part of an exceptional team that transforms ambitious visions into world-class hospitality experiences. About Our Client Butter Protein Club is a biohacker-inspired fitness nutrition hub in Pererenan, Bali, driven by the ethos: "Built for performance. Powered by beef." The brand focuses on 100% seed-oil-free, animal-based, customizable protein bowls with exact calorie counts, serving a growing community of fitness enthusiasts in a vibrant, dog-friendly environment. As the business continues to grow, maintaining consistent ingredient quality, reliable supply, competitive purchasing costs, and strict adherence to product standards is essential. We are seeking a commercially minded and detail-oriented procurement professional who can build strong supplier relationships while ensuring the business receives the right products at the right quality, price, and time. What You Will Contribute As the Head of Procurement at Butter Protein Club, you will be responsible for overseeing and developing the overall procurement function of the business. Working closely with the General Manager and operational teams, you will ensure the business has a reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality supply chain that supports daily operations and future growth. You will take ownership of supplier sourcing, purchasing, negotiations, inventory coordination, cost control, and procurement standards. A key part of your role will be ensuring that all ingredients and products comply with Butter Protein Club's strict product philosophy, including its 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based concept. Your commercial judgment, supplier network, negotiation skills, and attention to detail will directly contribute to product consistency, operational efficiency, and overall profitability. What You Will Do Lead and manage the overall procurement function for Butter Protein Club. Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business requirements, product standards, and financial objectives. Source, evaluate, and establish relationships with reliable local and international suppliers where appropriate. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, lead times, and other commercial terms with suppliers. Ensure all purchased ingredients, products, and supplies meet the required quality, specifications, and brand standards. Ensure strict compliance with the company's 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based ingredient requirements. Work closely with the General Manager, Head Chef, and operational teams to understand purchasing requirements and forecast demand. Monitor purchasing activities to ensure the right quantity and quality of products are available at the right time. Develop and maintain an approved supplier list and regularly assess supplier performance. Conduct regular price comparisons and market checks to ensure competitive purchasing costs. Monitor food and beverage purchasing costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality. Manage purchase orders, supplier quotations, invoices, and other procurement documentation accurately. Coordinate with the kitchen and operations teams regarding stock requirements, product specifications, and delivery schedules. Monitor supplier delivery performance, product availability, quality, and consistency. Handle supplier issues, discrepancies, rejected products, shortages, and delayed deliveries promptly. Work closely with inventory and operations teams to minimize overstocking, stock-outs, spoilage, and unnecessary wastage. Support accurate inventory control through regular stock checks, reconciliation, and procurement planning. Maintain accurate procurement records, pricing databases, supplier information, and purchasing reports. Monitor market trends, commodity pricing, and availability of key ingredients to support effective purchasing decisions. Identify alternative suppliers and products to minimize supply-chain risks and maintain business continuity. Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, food safety requirements, and applicable Indonesian regulations. Support the development of procurement SOPs, purchasing procedures, and supplier evaluation systems. Prepare regular procurement reports and provide recommendations to the General Manager regarding cost, supplier performance, and purchasing strategy. Continuously identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, product quality, supplier performance, and overall profitability. Who We're Looking For Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing within the hospitality, restaurant, F&B, or food-related industry. Previous experience in a Procurement Manager, Purchasing Manager, Head of Procurement, or similar leadership role is highly preferred. Strong understanding of F&B procurement, including fresh produce, meat, dairy, dry goods, beverages, and other restaurant supplies. Strong knowledge of local supplier networks and the Bali F&B supply market. Proven experience in supplier sourcing, evaluation, negotiation, and relationship management. Strong commercial and negotiation skills with a proven ability to achieve competitive purchasing costs. Good understanding of food costs, COGS, inventory management, stock control, and purchasing budgets. Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and administrative skills. Ability to evaluate product quality, specifications, pricing, and supplier reliability. Experience developing and maintaining supplier databases, purchasing records, and procurement reports. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond quickly to supply and operational challenges. Proactive and commercially minded, with the ability to identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities. Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced restaurant environment where product availability and consistency are critical. Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken. High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism when managing suppliers and company purchasing activities. What We Offer Competitive salary (negotiable based on qualifications) Religious Holiday Allowance (THR) BPJS Health & Employment Coverage Meal Allowance Service Charge Career growth opportunities within a growing hospitality and F&B business

A key part of your role will be ensuring that all ingredients and products comply with Butter Protein Club's strict product philosophy, including its 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based concept.

Your commercial judgment, supplier network, negotiation skills, and attention to detail will directly contribute to product consistency, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.

What You Will Do

  • Lead and manage the overall procurement function for Butter Protein Club.

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business requirements, product standards, and financial objectives.

  • Source, evaluate, and establish relationships with reliable local and international suppliers where appropriate.

  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, lead times, and other commercial terms with suppliers.

  • Ensure all purchased ingredients, products, and supplies meet the required quality, specifications, and brand standards.

  • Ensure strict compliance with the company's 100% seed-oil-free and animal-based ingredient requirements.

  • Work closely with the General Manager, Head Chef, and operational teams to understand purchasing requirements and forecast demand.

  • Monitor purchasing activities to ensure the right quantity and quality of products are available at the right time.

  • Develop and maintain an approved supplier list and regularly assess supplier performance.

  • Conduct regular price comparisons and market checks to ensure competitive purchasing costs.

  • Monitor food and beverage purchasing costs and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising quality.

  • Manage purchase orders, supplier quotations, invoices, and other procurement documentation accurately.

  • Coordinate with the kitchen and operations teams regarding stock requirements, product specifications, and delivery schedules.

  • Monitor supplier delivery performance, product availability, quality, and consistency.

  • Handle supplier issues, discrepancies, rejected products, shortages, and delayed deliveries promptly.

  • Work closely with inventory and operations teams to minimize overstocking, stock-outs, spoilage, and unnecessary wastage.

  • Support accurate inventory control through regular stock checks, reconciliation, and procurement planning.

  • Maintain accurate procurement records, pricing databases, supplier information, and purchasing reports.

  • Monitor market trends, commodity pricing, and availability of key ingredients to support effective purchasing decisions.

  • Identify alternative suppliers and products to minimize supply-chain risks and maintain business continuity.

  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, food safety requirements, and applicable Indonesian regulations.

  • Support the development of procurement SOPs, purchasing procedures, and supplier evaluation systems.

  • Prepare regular procurement reports and provide recommendations to the General Manager regarding cost, supplier performance, and purchasing strategy.

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve procurement efficiency, product quality, supplier performance, and overall profitability.

Who We're Looking For

  • Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in procurement, purchasing, supply chain, or sourcing within the hospitality, restaurant, F&B, or food-related industry.

  • Previous experience in a Procurement Manager, Purchasing Manager, Head of Procurement, or similar leadership role is highly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of F&B procurement, including fresh produce, meat, dairy, dry goods, beverages, and other restaurant supplies.

  • Strong knowledge of local supplier networks and the Bali F&B supply market.

  • Proven experience in supplier sourcing, evaluation, negotiation, and relationship management.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills with a proven ability to achieve competitive purchasing costs.

  • Good understanding of food costs, COGS, inventory management, stock control, and purchasing budgets.

  • Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational and administrative skills.

  • Ability to evaluate product quality, specifications, pricing, and supplier reliability.

  • Experience developing and maintaining supplier databases, purchasing records, and procurement reports.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to respond quickly to supply and operational challenges.

  • Proactive and commercially minded, with the ability to identify cost-saving and efficiency opportunities.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with suppliers and internal teams.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced restaurant environment where product availability and consistency are critical.

  • Good command of English and Bahasa Indonesia, both written and spoken.

  • High level of integrity, accountability, and professionalism when managing suppliers and company purchasing activities.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (negotiable based on qualifications)

  • Religious Holiday Allowance (THR)

  • BPJS Health & Employment Coverage

  • Meal Allowance

  • Service Charge

  • Career growth opportunities within a growing hospitality and F&B business

jobs.title: PURCHASING
jobs.description: Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Akuntansi, Manajemen, atau bidang terkait . Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang Purchasing/Procurement , diutamakan dari industri manufaktur, F&B, atau retail . Memahami dasar akuntansi, khususnya terkait jurnal pembelian dan hutang usaha . Mampu melakukan olah data, kontrol stok, dan monitoring inventory . Mampu melakukan koordinasi lintas divisi, khususnya dengan Finance, Gudang, dan Produksi . Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, analisis, dan problem solving yang kuat . Familiar dengan Jurnal.id menjadi nilai tambah.

jobs.title: APOTEKER / PENANGGUNG JAWAB TEKNIS (PJT) PKRT
jobs.description: Kami adalah perusahaan manufaktur Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang fragrance dan home fragrance , dengan produk seperti scented candle, reed diffuser, room spray, dan berbagai produk fragrance lainnya. Seiring dengan perkembangan bisnis dan peningkatan kapasitas produksi, kami sedang mencari Apoteker / Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT yang bertanggung jawab, teliti, dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Posisi ini merupakan peran yang cukup luas, tidak hanya berfokus pada aspek regulasi, tetapi juga akan terlibat langsung dalam produksi, quality control, inventory/stock management, reporting, dan administrasi operasional . Kami mencari seseorang yang dapat menjadi bagian penting dalam membangun sistem produksi dan dokumentasi perusahaan yang rapi, konsisten, dan sesuai dengan standar yang berlaku. Tanggung Jawab Regulasi & PJT PKRT Bertindak sebagai Penanggung Jawab Teknis (PJT) PKRT perusahaan. Memastikan kegiatan produksi dan dokumentasi memenuhi ketentuan PKRT dan CPPKRTB yang berlaku. Mengelola dan menjaga kelengkapan dokumen terkait regulasi dan perizinan. Membantu proses pendaftaran, perizinan, dan pengurusan dokumen PKRT. Menyiapkan dan menjaga dokumen yang diperlukan untuk audit atau inspeksi. Membuat, memperbarui, dan memastikan penerapan SOP terkait produksi dan quality control. Memastikan dokumentasi produksi dan quality control dilakukan secara konsisten. Produksi & Quality Control Memantau kegiatan produksi sehari-hari. Memastikan proses produksi berjalan sesuai SOP, formula, dan spesifikasi yang telah ditetapkan. Melakukan review terhadap production report dan batch documentation. Memantau kualitas bahan baku dan produk jadi. Membantu proses testing dan stability testing produk. Mengidentifikasi dan membantu menyelesaikan masalah kualitas atau penyimpangan produksi. Berkoordinasi dengan tim produksi untuk menjaga konsistensi kualitas produk. Stock & Inventory Mengelola pencatatan stok bahan baku, packaging, dan produk jadi. Melakukan stock opname dan stock reconciliation secara berkala. Memantau penggunaan bahan baku dan packaging. Memastikan pencatatan batch, tanggal produksi, dan expiry date dilakukan dengan baik apabila diperlukan. Memastikan bahan baku dan produk disimpan dengan baik sesuai kebutuhan. Reporting & Administrasi Membuat daily/weekly/monthly production report . Membuat dan menjaga laporan stok. Mengelola dokumen produksi, QC, dan regulasi. Memastikan seluruh dokumentasi tersusun secara rapi dan mudah ditelusuri. Membantu pekerjaan administrasi operasional lainnya yang berkaitan dengan produksi dan regulasi. Membantu management dalam penyusunan laporan dan dokumentasi perusahaan. Kualifikasi Wajib Lulusan dan memiliki profesi Apoteker . Memiliki izin/registrasi Apoteker yang masih aktif dan valid . Izin/registrasi Apoteker tidak sedang digunakan, terdaftar, atau terikat sebagai penanggung jawab pada perusahaan lain . Memiliki sertifikasi PJT PKRT . Memiliki sertifikat pelatihan CPPKRTB yang masih berlaku/diakui . Bersedia menjadi PJT PKRT perusahaan secara full-time . Bersedia bekerja full-time dan on-site di Jakarta . Memiliki kemampuan administrasi dan dokumentasi yang baik. Teliti, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri. Kualifikasi yang Diutamakan Memiliki pengalaman sebelumnya sebagai PJT PKRT . Memiliki pengalaman dalam proses CPPKRTB dan regulasi PKRT. Memiliki pengalaman di bidang manufaktur, production, quality control, atau regulatory affairs. Memiliki pengalaman di industri fragrance, home fragrance, kosmetik, household products , atau industri terkait menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami prinsip GMP dan quality management. Terbiasa menggunakan Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets . Mampu membuat laporan dan mengelola dokumentasi secara sistematis. Kami Mencari Kandidat yang... Teliti dan sangat memperhatikan detail. Bertanggung jawab dan dapat dipercaya. Terorganisir dan memiliki kemampuan administrasi yang baik. Tidak hanya menunggu instruksi, tetapi mampu melihat masalah dan mencari solusi. Nyaman bekerja dalam lingkungan perusahaan yang sedang berkembang. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri sekaligus berkoordinasi dengan tim produksi. Memiliki mindset problem-solving dan continuous improvement. Yang Kami Tawarkan Posisi full-time dengan peran penting dalam perusahaan yang sedang berkembang. Kesempatan untuk terlibat langsung dalam manufacturing, product development, regulatory, dan quality control . Lingkungan kerja yang dinamis dan entrepreneurial. Kesempatan untuk berkembang bersama perusahaan seiring dengan ekspansi bisnis. Cara Melamar Mohon kirimkan: CV terbaru. Bukti ijazah/profesi Apoteker. Bukti izin/registrasi Apoteker yang masih aktif . Sertifikat PJT PKRT . Sertifikat pelatihan CPPKRTB . Dokumen pendukung atau referensi kerja jika tersedia. PENTING: Kandidat wajib memiliki izin/registrasi Apoteker yang aktif dan tidak sedang digunakan atau terdaftar pada perusahaan lain , serta bersedia menjadi PJT PKRT perusahaan secara full-time .

jobs.description: We are seeking a talented Website Designer on a casual basis , based remotely. In this role, you will play a crucial part in creating and maintaining an engaging digital presence for our travel brand. This position offers the flexibility of casual work, allowing you to contribute your creative skills while maintaining work-life balance. Key responsibilities Design and create visually appealing web pages, layouts and user interfaces for the https://pindito.com Collaborate with marketing and content teams to translate travel concepts keep content fresh and aligned with current brand guidelines Incorporate travel imagery, maps and interactive elements to enhance the browsing experience Work with web developers to ensure designs are effectively implemented and function as intended Optimise website performance and loading times through efficient design practices Stay informed of current web design trends and best practices within the travel industry What we're looking for Proven experience in web design and digital production, with a strong portfolio demonstrating your previous work Proficiency in web design software and tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, XD, Illustrator), Figma or similar platforms Solid understanding of user experience (UX) and user interface (UI) design principles Knowledge of HTML, CSS and responsive design techniques Experience designing for travel, hospitality or tourism industries is highly desirable Strong attention to detail and ability to work with precision Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a flexible, casual work arrangement Familiarity with web analytics and SEO best practices is advantageous A creative mindset with the ability to translate concepts into compelling visual designs What we offer Flexible casual work arrangement allowing you to balance your professional commitments with personal pursuits The opportunity to work on exciting travel-related projects that inspire creativity and innovation A collaborative and supportive team environment where your ideas are valued Exposure to a dynamic industry with the chance to develop your skills in web design and digital production The privilege of working in beautiful Bali, contributing to a growing travel brand Professional development opportunities to enhance your design capabilities

jobs.title: Kasir
jobs.description: Tentang Kami Appel House adalah perusahaan yang berdedikasi dalam industri Retail & Consumer Products dengan fokus pada penjualan dan pembelian produk berkualitas. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman berbelanja terbaik kepada setiap pelanggan melalui layanan yang excellent, produk berkualitas, dan tim yang profesional. Tanggung Jawab Utama Melayani pelanggan dengan ramah dan profesional pada setiap transaksi penjualan di meja kasir. Memproses pembayaran dengan akurat menggunakan sistem kasir modern, termasuk tunai, kartu kredit, dan metode pembayaran digital lainnya. Integritas tinggi dan dapat dipercaya dalam menangani uang dan aset perusahaan.

jobs.title: Full-Stack AI Engineer (Backend-Leaning)
jobs.description: Full-Stack AI Engineer (Backend-Leaning) Location: Jakarta, Indonesia Work Arrangement: On-site Employment Type: Full-time Salary: IDR 14,000,000–20,000,000/month, depending on experience and capability About the Company We are building a digital employee team for North American real estate agents. Our AI-powered digital employees operate through WhatsApp and are designed to perform real operational tasks, including tracking transaction deadlines, managing follow-ups, drafting property listings and social media content, and supporting administrative workflows. We are looking for a Full-Stack AI Engineer with a strong backend focus to help design and develop the infrastructure powering these AI employees. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain backend systems supporting AI agent orchestration, tool execution, task queues, scheduling, memory, and state management. Build and maintain integrations with WhatsApp, calendars, email, MLS, and real estate transaction systems. Develop reliable production systems with appropriate idempotency, retry mechanisms, observability, and evaluation processes. Develop user-facing features and interfaces when required. Build and maintain LLM-based agents capable of handling real-world user interactions. Implement tool use, memory, state management, error handling, and other components required for reliable AI agents. Collaborate with the team to identify technical issues and continuously improve system reliability and performance. Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor to improve development efficiency and output. Pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang HR, lebih diutamakan yang memiliki pengalaman di sektor pertambangan. Pengetahuan mengenai peraturan ketenagakerjaan Indonesia dan praktik hubungan industrial. Memahami dan dapat melakukan proses Recruitment, UU Ketenagakerjaan, BPJS dan Payroll Terbiasa melakukan coaching dan konseling Domisili di Balikpapan/Samarinda (Mess tidak tersedia)

jobs.description: Toddler Teacher Apple Tree Pre-School – PIK 2 Apple Tree Pre-School is looking for a caring, enthusiastic, and dedicated Toddler Teacher to join our team. The ideal candidate will enjoy working with children and be passionate about creating a safe, happy, and engaging environment where toddlers can learn, explore, and grow. We are committed to providing a nurturing learning environment that supports children's development and helps them build confidence, independence, and positive social skills. Support toddlers' social, emotional, language, cognitive, and physical development. Encourage positive behaviour and guide children using appropriate classroom management strategies. Observe and monitor children's progress and provide appropriate support based on their individual needs. Communicate regularly and professionally with parents regarding children's progress, needs, and achievements. Work collaboratively with Teacher Assistants, teachers, and school staff. Maintain a clean, organized, and engaging classroom environment. Follow school policies and health and safety procedures. Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Early Childhood Education, Preschool Education, Education, or a related field. Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Previous teaching experience, preferably with toddlers or preschool-aged children. Patient, caring, energetic, creative, and responsible. Able to work well under pressure and manage classroom routines effectively. Confident in singing and familiar with children's songs and activities. Good communication and interpersonal skills. A team player and proficient in Microsoft Office Suite. Able to build positive relationships with children, parents, and colleagues. How to Apply Please submit your Curriculum Vitae (CV), highest educational certificate, and reference letter(s) to: ••••@gmail.com

Kami mencari Barista yang berpengalaman, energik, dan berorientasi pada layanan pelanggan untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Dalam peran ini, Anda akan menjadi wajah dari brand kami dan memainkan peran penting dalam menciptakan pengalaman makan dan minum yang luar biasa bagi tamu kami. Kemampuan berkomunikasi yang baik dan berorientasi pada layanan pelanggan yang unggul Memiliki ketelitian dan kecepatan dalam bekerja serta dapat bekerja di bawah tekanan Bersemangat, energik, dan antusias untuk mengembangkan keterampilan barista Anda Tentang Jardin Jardin adalah restoran dan kafe bergengsi di Malang yang terkenal dengan menu makanan dan minumannya yang lezat dan berkualitas tinggi. This is a Business Development position focused on identifying and developing new business opportunities across target industries in Industrial Automation and Engineering Solutions.

  • Willing to travel locally for customer visits and business activities when required

jobs.title: Quality, Hygiene, Safety & Environment Supervisor
jobs.description: Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety (K3), Environmental Health, Public Health, or a related field. At least 3 years of experience in as an Quality, Hygiene, Safety, or related role within the Hospitality industry (hotel, resort, or restaurant). Candidates with proven experience in hotel, resort, or hospitality operations are strongly preferred. Hold a General OHS Expert Candidate (Calon Ahli K3 Umum) certification (mandatory) from the Indonesian Ministry of Manpower. HACCP, Food Safety, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, or other relevant certifications/training will be an advantage. Familiar with food safety procedures and fire safety systems commonly applied in hospitality settings. Strong analytical skills in conducting risk assessments & incidents investigations. Able to work on a shift system and respond to emergency situations outside normal working hours. Able to conduct training and awareness programs related to hygiene, food safety, occupational health & safety, emergency preparedness, and environmental practices. Willing to work in a hotel/resort operational environment in Bali and interact closely with both operational and support departments.

Posisi ini memerlukan kemampuan kepemimpinan yang kuat, perhatian terhadap detail, dan pemahaman mendalam tentang proses manufaktur. Ini adalah posisi fulltime yang ditempatkan di Batam, Kepulauan Riau .

jobs.description: About the role Cook bertanggung jawab untuk menyiapkan, memasak, dan menyajikan makanan sesuai standar resep, kualitas, dan presentasi perusahaan. Posisi ini juga memastikan kebersihan area dapur, menjaga kualitas bahan baku, serta mendukung kelancaran operasional kitchen setiap hari. Key responsibilities Menyiapkan bahan makanan (food preparation) sebelum operasional dimulai. Memasak dan menyajikan makanan sesuai resep, standar kualitas, dan waktu penyajian yang telah ditetapkan. Memastikan setiap hidangan memiliki rasa, porsi, dan tampilan yang konsisten. Menjaga kebersihan area dapur, peralatan memasak, dan area penyimpanan sesuai standar higiene dan sanitasi. Melakukan pengecekan kualitas dan kesegaran bahan baku sebelum digunakan. Menyimpan bahan makanan sesuai standar FIFO (First In, First Out) dan prosedur penyimpanan. Mengontrol penggunaan bahan baku untuk meminimalkan pemborosan. Berkoordinasi dengan Service Crew untuk memastikan pesanan pelanggan disajikan dengan cepat dan akurat. Melaporkan kebutuhan bahan baku kepada atasan. Mematuhi seluruh Standar Operasional Prosedur (SOP), kebersihan, dan keselamatan kerja di dapur. About you Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK, diutamakan jurusan Tata Boga atau Perhotelan. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Cook di restoran, café, bakery, atau industri Food & Beverage menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami teknik dasar memasak dan food preparation. Memiliki pengetahuan mengenai standar kebersihan, sanitasi, dan keamanan pangan. Disiplin, jujur, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur. Benefits Gaji kompetitif. Service charge (sesuai kebijakan perusahaan). Kesempatan pengembangan karier. Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, bersih, dan suportif.

jobs.title: Server
jobs.description: Your Role in this Journey: Greet guests warmly and professionally upon arrival. Present menus and provide detailed information about food and beverage items. Take accurate food and drink orders and input them into the POS system. Serve food and beverages promptly while ensuring correct presentation. Always mention the name of the menu item when serving. Ensure tables are properly set, clean, and organized before and after service. Check guest satisfaction during service and handle complaints politely and efficiently. Clear used plates, glasses, and cutlery in a courteous and timely manner. Coordinate with the kitchen and bar team for smooth service operations. Maintain cleanliness and hygiene standards in all service areas. Follow all standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety regulations. Assist in upselling food, beverages, and promotions to guests. Maintain a professional appearance and positive attitude at all times. Who We’re Excited to Meet: Required Skills: Minimum high school diploma or equivalent. Previous experience as a server in a restaurant, bar, hotel, or rooftop venue is preferred. Good communication skills in English (additional languages are a plus). Friendly, polite, and service-oriented personality. Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Strong teamwork and coordination skills. Good knowledge of food, beverages, and basic service standards. Physically fit and able to stand for long working hours. Willing to work flexible hours, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. Neat appearance and good personal hygiene. Preferred Qualification: Previous experience in hospitality, restaurants, cafés, bars, beach clubs, or hotels is an advantage. Strong passion for customer service and creating exceptional guest experiences. Good communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Positive attitude, professional appearance, and excellent interpersonal skills. Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. Strong teamwork, adaptability, and willingness to learn. Basic knowledge of food and beverage service, cocktails, coffee, or wine is preferred (depending on the position). Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and evening operations. Strong sense of responsibility, discipline, and attention to detail. Experience using POS systems and basic computer skills is an advantage. Food Safety & Hygiene certification is preferred. Candidates with barista, bartender, WSET, or other hospitality certifications will have an advantage (where applicable). Ability to handle guest complaints professionally and maintain high service standards. Demonstrates initiative, problem-solving skills, and a commitment to continuous improvement. Recruitment Details: ㆍ Application > Aptitude Test > 1st Interview > 2nd Interview > Compensation Negotiation > Final Onboarding Your Team At Canggu Sunset Club, we are more than just a Food & Beverage team we are passionate hospitality professionals dedicated to creating unforgettable experiences for every guest. Located in the heart of BWork Bali, Canggu Sunset Club offers a unique destination where guests can enjoy handcrafted beverages, delicious cuisine, breathtaking sunsets, and exceptional service in a relaxed and vibrant atmosphere. Our success is built on teamwork, professionalism, and a shared commitment to excellence. Every team member, from service staff and bartenders to kitchen and support teams, plays an essential role in ensuring that every guest receives warm hospitality, consistent quality, and memorable experiences. We are committed to: Delivering exceptional guest service with genuine care and professionalism. Maintaining the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, and operational excellence. Working together with integrity, respect, and accountability. Continuously learning, improving, and embracing innovation. Supporting one another to achieve both individual and team success. Creating a positive, welcoming, and energetic environment for both guests and colleagues. At Canggu Sunset Club, we believe that hospitality is about more than serving food and drinks it is about building connections, creating lasting memories, and making every guest feel welcome. Every smile, every cocktail, every dish, and every interaction reflects our dedication to excellence. Company Introduction Daewoong Bio Indonesia (DBI) is part of Korea’s Daewoong Group, expanding its global healthcare vision into hospitality in Bali. Building on the success of BWork , Bali’s No.1 coworking space, DBI is growing into coliving, wellness hubs, villas, and resorts including BLive, BFriends, BNesta, Munduk Wellness Resort, and AlamKulKul . Led by experts from Korea’s 5-star hotel and premium spa industries, we create hospitality experiences that connect work, wellness, and community , while contributing to Bali’s economy and global reputation as a wellness destination. Our Commitment at Daewoong: Top-Tier Rewards: Competitive salary and performance-based incentives. Autonomy & Growth: A workplace that trusts you to lead, learn, and grow. Meaningful Work: Contribute to a triple win — employee growth, customer satisfaction, and societal advancement. Expert Training: Direct learning from Korean hospitality and wellness leaders. Global Opportunities: From Korea trips to overseas placements, your career can go international. Our Culture At Daewoong, we believe healthcare is more than medicine; it’s about creating better lives. Guided by our WIN-WIN-WIN philosophy, we grow together with our people, customers, and society. We value autonomy, encouraging our team to work in their own best way, choosing where, when, and how they feel most focused. Growth is our priority: we set bold goals, learn continuously, and embrace feedback. Here, work isn’t just a job; it’s a chance to do something meaningful and impactful. Why Daewoong? Daewoong is a global healthcare leader founded in 1945, with operations in 100+ countries, 8 overseas branches, 5 R&D centers, and 4,500+ employees worldwide. In Indonesia, we employ over 360 professionals across Jakarta, Bali, Bekasi, and Surabaya. We’ve been recognized as: Best Workplace in Asia (2023) Best Workplace in Korea (2022) Outstanding Foreign Investment Company – Indonesian Government (2022) Women-Friendly Culture & Diversity Management Award (2022) Global Pharmaceutical R&D Innovation Award (2021) Best Innovation in Biotechnology – Metro TV (2025) Here, your talent is trusted, your growth is accelerated, and your impact is global. jobs.title: Finance Accounting Tax Manager (Mandarin Speaker)
jobs.description: Qualifications & Experience •⁠ Minimum D3/S1 graduate in Accounting/Finance, •⁠ ⁠Minimum 2 years work experience as FAT Supervisor, or FAT Manager and has worked in a Fintech Company, •⁠ ⁠Having a Brevet A&B Certificate is preferred, •⁠ ⁠Fluent in Mandarin, •⁠ ⁠Have Certificate HSK •⁠ ⁠Have used and know the Accurate system and DJP Online, •⁠ ⁠Understand and have good knowledge of Financial Accounting and Taxation Standards in Indonesia, •⁠ ⁠Have expertise in the field of Finance; Banking, cash flow monitoring, AR & AP, •⁠ ⁠Familiar with working on financial reports and can manage Petty Cash, •⁠ ⁠Have the ability to do a lot of work in a short time (multitasking), honest, thorough, detailed, proactive, and has good analytical skills, •⁠ ⁠Strong knowledge of OJK regulation Tasks & Responsibilities •⁠ ⁠Prepare and manage financial reports such as Petty Cash, e-Invoicing, e-Payment Slip, e-SPT, •⁠ ⁠Prepare bank reconciliation, transaction input, tax reporting (PPh 21, PPh 23, PPh 26, UMKM), •⁠ ⁠Assist in the preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly and annual financial reports, •⁠ ⁠Maintain confidentiality of important information and documents, •⁠ ⁠Prepare journals, Account Payable (AP) and Account Receivable (AR) documents, •⁠ ⁠Assist and comply with direct superiors for any assigned work and tasks •⁠ ⁠Analyze financial data and prepare reports for direct superiors, and management, •⁠ ⁠Perform other work related to the Finance, Accounting & Tax department •⁠ ⁠⁠Prepare and file regulatory reports with OJK, •⁠ ⁠⁠Manage the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes •⁠ ⁠⁠Oversee the accurate and timely preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements

jobs.title: Warehouse Supervisor
jobs.description: Uraian Tugas : Mengelola proses packing, penimbangan, pelabelan, dan scanning barang hingga menjadi stok siap kirim. Memastikan akurasi dan ketersediaan stok melalui monitoring serta stock opname secara berkala. Mengatur proses loading dan transportasi pengiriman ke Gudang ABU dengan menerapkan sistem FIFO (First In, First Out) . Mengontrol ketersediaan consumable packing untuk memastikan operasional warehouse berjalan lancar. Memastikan tim memahami dan menjalankan Work Instruction (WI) dan SOP sesuai standar perusahaan. Melakukan review dan improvement proses kerja untuk menjaga akurasi, efisiensi, dan ketertiban operasional warehouse. Wewenang : Memberikan rekomendasi terhadap proses di gudang yang lebih efektif & efisien. Requirements : Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Supervisor Warehouse , dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di Cold Storage . Memahami Warehouse Management, Product & Material Handling Equipment . Memiliki kemampuan dalam pengelolaan stok, alur barang, dan operasional pergudangan . Mampu memimpin tim dan memastikan operasional berjalan sesuai SOP dan target perusahaan . Placement : Pasuruan (RPA)

jobs.title: Admin Penjualan
jobs.description: Kesempatan PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima mencari seorang Admin Penjualan yang terorganisir, detail-oriented, dan responsif untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Gamping, DI Yogyakarta. Sebagai Admin Penjualan, Anda akan menjadi tulang punggung operasional tim penjualan kami, memastikan semua proses administratif berjalan lancar dan mendukung kesuksesan penjualan perusahaan. Posisi ini adalah peran waktu penuh yang menawarkan kesempatan untuk berkontribusi langsung pada pertumbuhan bisnis kami sambil mengembangkan keterampilan administratif yang komprehensif. Kandidat ideal memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang excellent, keterampilan organisasi yang luar biasa, dan komitmen terhadap keunggulan layanan. Tanggung Jawab Mengelola dan memperbarui database penjualan, termasuk data pelanggan, quotation, dan pesanan dengan akurat dan tepat waktu. Memproses pesanan penjualan dan memastikan semua dokumentasi lengkap sebelum dikirimkan ke departemen lain. Menyiapkan dan mengirimkan quotation, invoice, dan dokumen penjualan lainnya kepada pelanggan. Mengelola jadwal dan appointment tim penjualan, mengatur meeting, dan koordinasi dengan departemen terkait. Memberikan dukungan administratif kepada tim penjualan dalam hal follow-up pelanggan, tracking pesanan, dan resolusi masalah. Mempersiapkan laporan penjualan harian, mingguan, dan bulanan dengan format yang terstruktur dan akurat. Mengelola komunikasi email dan telepon dengan profesional dan responsif. Mengarsipkan dan mengorganisir dokumen penjualan sesuai dengan prosedur perusahaan. Mendukung kegiatan promosi penjualan dan event pemasaran sesuai kebutuhan. Persyaratan Lulusan SMA/SMK atau diploma (D3) dalam bidang Administrasi, Perkantoran, atau bidang terkait. Minimal 2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Admin Penjualan atau posisi administratif serupa di industri yang relevan. Kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang excellent dalam Bahasa Indonesia dan diutamakan Bahasa Inggris dasar. Menguasai Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) dengan profisiensi tinggi, khususnya Excel untuk data entry dan laporan. Familiar dengan sistem CRM atau software penjualan akan menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki keterampilan organisasi dan manajemen waktu yang sangat baik dalam menangani multi-tasking. Teliti, akurat dalam bekerja dengan standar tinggi dalam penanganan data dan dokumentasi. Sikap profesional, responsif, dan kemampuan problem-solving yang baik. Diutamakan memiliki pengalaman dalam industri penjualan produk atau jasa. Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan keterampilan. Tunjangan kesehatan dan asuransi jaminan sosial sesuai peraturan perusahaan. Cuti tahunan dan cuti bersama sesuai dengan ketentuan yang berlaku. Lingkungan kerja yang professional, mendukung, dan kolaboratif. Peluang pengembangan karir dan pelatihan profesional untuk meningkatkan kompetensi. Program bonus kinerja berdasarkan pencapaian target. Lokasi kerja strategis dengan akses transportasi yang mudah di Gamping, Yogyakarta. Tentang Kami PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima adalah perusahaan yang berkomitmen untuk memberikan solusi bisnis terbaik dan layanan berkualitas tinggi kepada pelanggan kami. Dengan visi untuk menjadi mitra terpercaya dalam pertumbuhan bisnis klien, kami terus berinovasi dan mengembangkan produk serta layanan yang relevan dengan kebutuhan pasar. Budaya perusahaan kami menekankan integritas, kerja keras, dan kolaborasi tim. Kami percaya bahwa setiap anggota tim memiliki peran penting dalam kesuksesan perusahaan, dan kami berkomitmen untuk menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang inklusif, mendukung pengembangan profesional setiap karyawan, dan menghargai kontribusi mereka terhadap pertumbuhan bersama. Cara Melamar Jika Anda tertarik dengan posisi ini dan memenuhi kriteria yang kami cari, kami mengundang Anda untuk lamar sekarang . Silakan siapkan CV, surat lamaran, dan dokumen pendukung lainnya. Kami menunggu kehadiran Anda untuk menjadi bagian dari tim PT. Sumber Inspirasi Prima!

jobs.title: Designer Grafis dan Illustrator
jobs.description: Deskripsi pekerjaan Syarat – Syarat : Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Desain Komunikasi Visual (DKV), Seni Rupa, atau bidang terkait . Memiliki kemampuan menggambar ilustrasi manual maupun digital . Menguasai software desain seperti Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, atau software ilustrasi lainnya . Kreatif, inovatif, dan memiliki sense visual yang baik . Mampu membuat ilustrasi yang sesuai dengan materi buku (edukatif dan komunikatif) . Memahami dasar layout, komposisi warna, dan tipografi . Teliti, detail, dan mampu bekerja sesuai deadline produksi buku . Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim (editor, penulis, dan tim produksi). Memiliki portofolio ilustrasi (lebih diutamakan ilustrasi pendidikan / buku anak / buku pelajaran). Tugas Tanggung Jawab (Job Description) : Membuat design cover buku dan ilustrasi gambar untuk kebutuhan buku (buku pelajaran, buku anak, atau buku edukasi). Menerjemahkan konsep materi dari editor atau penulis menjadi ilustrasi yang mudah dipahami pembaca. Membuat gambar pendukung materi seperti diagram, karakter, infografik, dan visual pembelajaran. Mengolah ilustrasi agar sesuai dengan layout dan desain buku . Melakukan revisi ilustrasi sesuai arahan editor atau tim produksi . Menyesuaikan ilustrasi dengan standar visual dan gaya desain penerbit . Bekerja sama dengan editor, penulis, dan tim layout dalam proses produksi buku. Membantu pembuatan ilustrasi untuk kebutuhan promosi buku (poster, katalog, media sosial). Menjaga konsistensi kualitas visual ilustrasi pada setiap proyek buku.

jobs.title: Supervisor Office Operation
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Supervisor Office Operation yang berpengalaman dan terorganisir untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di PT Luxen Makmur Sejahtera. Tanggung Jawab Bertanggung jawab atas kelancaran seluruh kegiatan operasional kantor dan warehouse sehari-hari. Mengawasi dan mengkoordinasikan kebutuhan operasional serta fasilitas kantor dan warehouse. Memimpin dan melakukan monitoring terhadap tim office support. Mengatur kebutuhan perlengkapan, peralatan, dan fasilitas kerja kantor serta warehouse. Melakukan koordinasi dengan vendor dan supplier terkait kebutuhan operasional perusahaan. Memastikan kondisi fasilitas, area kerja, dan lingkungan kantor tetap dalam kondisi baik, aman, dan nyaman. Mengatur dan memonitor kebutuhan maintenance serta perbaikan fasilitas kantor dan warehouse. Mengontrol penggunaan aset dan perlengkapan operasional perusahaan. Mengawasi pengeluaran dan kebutuhan operasional agar efektif dan sesuai dengan anggaran. Menangani kendala operasional serta memastikan penyelesaiannya berjalan dengan cepat dan tepat. Berkoordinasi dengan seluruh departemen untuk memastikan kebutuhan operasional dapat terpenuhi. Membuat laporan operasional secara berkala kepada Management. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal S1, semua jurusan yang relevan. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang Office Operation, Office Management, atau Operational. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Supervisor/Leader menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan leadership dan koordinasi yang baik. Mampu mengelola kebutuhan operasional kantor dan fasilitas perusahaan. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan problem solving yang baik. Mampu mengelola vendor dan supplier. Terbiasa bekerja dengan target, deadline, dan multitasking. Menguasai Microsoft Office, terutama Excel dan Word. Teliti, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, proaktif, dan mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim

jobs.title: SECURITY
jobs.description: Peluang Kerja Globe National School 3 Nongsa di Batam, Kepulauan Riau, sedang mencari Security yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. Sebagai Security, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam menjaga keamanan dan kesejahteraan komunitas sekolah kami. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki komitmen kuat terhadap pelayanan publik, kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, dan pengalaman dalam menjaga keamanan di lingkungan yang dinamis. Tanggung Jawab Utama Menjaga keamanan dan keselamatan seluruh siswa, staf, dan pengunjung di lingkungan sekolah. Melakukan patroli rutin di seluruh area sekolah untuk mengawasi dan mencegah tindakan melanggar aturan atau kejadian yang tidak diinginkan. Menangani dan menyelesaikan insiden keamanan secara profesional dan tepat waktu. Memastikan pintu gerbang dan akses masuk-keluar sekolah dikontrol dengan ketat. Bekerjasama dengan pihak berwenang jika diperlukan dalam menangani situasi darurat. Membuat laporan harian terkait situasi keamanan di sekolah. Keterampilan dan Kualifikasi yang Dibutuhkan Pendidikan minimal setara SMA/SMK. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai Security atau petugas keamanan di lingkungan sekolah atau institusi serupa. Memahami prosedur dan protokol keamanan yang berlaku. Memiliki pengetahuan tentang penanganan situasi darurat dan prosedur evakuasi. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, baik secara lisan maupun tertulis. Disiplin, tanggap, dan dapat diandalkan. Manfaat Bekerja di Globe National School Gaji dan Tunjangan Hari Raya Lingkungan kerja yang aman, nyaman, dan mendukung. Kesempatan untuk berkontribusi pada pendidikan generasi muda. Tentang Kami Globe National School adalah sekolah swasta terkemuka di Batam, Kepulauan Riau, yang berkomitmen untuk menyediakan pendidikan berkualitas bagi siswa dari berbagai latar belakang. Kami menjunjung tinggi nilai-nilai integritas, keberagaman, dan inovasi dalam menciptakan lingkungan belajar yang inspiratif dan mendukung. Sebagai anggota komunitas Batam, kami bangga dapat berkontribusi pada pengembangan generasi masa depan yang tangguh dan beretika. Globe National School 3 Nongsa di Batam, Kepulauan Riau, sedang mencari Security yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami. jobs.title: IT Support
jobs.description: Persyaratan : Diploma atau gelar dalam bidang Teknologi Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau disiplin teknis terkait. Minimal 2-3 tahun pengalaman dalam peran IT Support atau Help Desk di lingkungan perusahaan. Pengetahuan mendalam tentang sistem operasi Windows dan Linux, serta troubleshooting hardware komputer. Kemampuan untuk mengelola jaringan dasar, konektivitas internet, dan wireless connectivity. Pengalaman dengan system ticketing dan asset management tools. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dan keterampilan interpersonal untuk berinteraksi dengan berbagai Departement. Kemampuan problem-solving yang kuat dengan pemikiran analitis dan perhatian terhadap detail. Memiliki pengetahuan terkait praktik ISO dan TAPA menjadi nilai tambah Ringkasan Pekerjaan : Bertanggung jawab atas operasional, pemeliharaan, dan dukungan teknis harian (helpdesk) untuk seluruh infrastruktur TI, perangkat keras, perangkat lunak, serta jaringan di lingkungan kantor dan gudang. Posisi ini juga mengelola keamanan sistem, kontrol akses fisik, inventaris aset IT, serta memastikan seluruh tata kelola dokumentasi mematuhi standar sertifikasi yang berlaku di perusahaan. Tanggung Jawab : User Helpdesk & Hardware/Software Support : Memberikan dukungan teknis harian (troubleshooting hardware dan software). Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, pemeliharaan rutin, serta perbaikan/penggantian perangkat kerja pengguna. Network & Infrastructure Maintenance: Memantau dan mengelola lalu lintas jaringan. Melakukan pembaruan firmware dan pemeliharaan rutin jaringan untuk menjaga stabilitas dan keamanan koneksi. System Security, Access Control & Physical Security: Mengelola manajemen akun pengguna Email dan hak akses. Memantau dan menguji sistem keamanan fisik kantor/gudang (CCTV dan alarm). Melakukan prosedur pencadangan ( backup ) dan pemulihan data ( recovery ) secara berkala. Asset Management & Vendor Coordination: Menyiapkan perangkat kerja dan akses akun untuk karyawan baru, serta melakukan pencabutan akses saat karyawan resign . Mengelola pencatatan inventaris aset IT melalui software AMS. Berkordinasi dengan vendor eksternal untuk pengadaan serta perbaikan perangkat keras/lunak. Dokumentasi & Compliance: Memberikan edukasi berkala kepada pengguna mengenai praktek keamanan siber dasar. Mencatat maintenance plan , menyusun user manual/guide . Memastikan seluruh dokumentasi, kontrol akses, dan kondisi perangkat keras mematuhi standar sertifikasi yang berlaku.

jobs.title: Network Engineering (Penempatan Surabaya)
jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Memimpin dan mengarahkan tim Network Engineer dalam operasional dan project jaringan. Menyusun network strategy, roadmap, capacity planning, dan improvement plan. Memastikan availability dan performance network sesuai SLA/KPI. Mengawasi konfigurasi dan pengelolaan router, switch, firewall, wireless, VPN, dan network security. Mengelola incident, problem, change, dan escalation terkait network infrastructure. Melakukan review dan approval terhadap network design, configuration, dan perubahan infrastructure. Memastikan penerapan security standard, policy, compliance, dan best practice. Mengelola network project mulai dari planning, implementation, testing, hingga handover. Berkoordinasi dengan vendor, ISP, principal, dan internal IT/business stakeholders. Mengelola capacity, budget, license, hardware/software lifecycle, dan vendor performance. Menyusun laporan performa network dan memberikan rekomendasi kepada IT Manager/Head. Melakukan coaching, mentoring, performance evaluation, dan pengembangan kompetensi anggota tim. Kualifikasi: S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Computer Science, atau bidang terkait. 5–8+ tahun pengalaman di bidang Network/Infrastructure, dengan pengalaman sebagai team lead/supervisor. Memiliki pengalaman memimpin tim teknis. Menguasai enterprise networking: routing, switching, VLAN, BGP/OSPF, VPN, SD-WAN, wireless, DNS/DHCP, dan network security. Berpengalaman dengan teknologi/vendor seperti Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Aruba, Juniper, atau equivalent. Memahami network monitoring, capacity planning, disaster recovery, dan high availability. Memahami ITIL, change management, incident/problem management. Memiliki kemampuan project management dan vendor management. Kemampuan komunikasi dan stakeholder management yang baik. Penempatan area Surabaya dan sekitarnya

jobs.title: Sales Assistant Manager
jobs.description: As MonotaRO Indonesia continues to grow rapidly, we're strengthening our Sales team this year! We are looking for a driven Sales Assistant Manager to lead sales initiatives, build strong customer relationships, and support our next phase of growth. This position will be based at our Head Office, Wisma KEIAI (Sudirman, Central Jakarta) . Key Responsibilities: 1. Customer Development & Online Lead Management Manage and nurture leads generated through e-commerce platforms and online marketing efforts. Develop strategies to convert leads into long-term customers through email campaigns, follow-ups, and CRM tools. Collaborate with the marketing team to optimize lead acquisition efforts and ensure seamless workflow to the sales team. 2. Direct Sales Support & Team Coordination Assist the tele-sales team in handling inbound and outbound calls to boost sales conversion rates. Support the development of sales scripts, objection-handling strategies, and training materials for the sales team. Monitor sales team performance and provide feedback for improvement. 3. Sales Operations & Performance Analysis Track and analyze sales data, customer behavior, and lead conversion rates to improve sales processes. Assist in setting sales targets, monitoring KPIs, and reporting performance to senior management. Optimize CRM usage for better lead tracking and customer management. 4. Customer Relationship Management & Retention Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers to drive repeat purchases. Gather customer feedback to improve sales processes and product offerings. Work closely with the customer service team to ensure excellent post-sales support and issue resolution. 5. Cross-Department Collaboration Coordinate with customer service, supply chain, and product teams to ensure smooth operations and customer satisfaction. Work with the marketing team on promotional campaigns and customer engagement initiatives. Collaborate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure order fulfillment and inventory availability. Provide feedback from sales interactions to the product team for product improvements and market demand alignment. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in B2B sales , preferably in MRO, industrial products, or e-commerce . Strong knowledge of CRM systems, lead nurturing, and digital sales strategies . Experience in managing or assisting a sales team is a plus. Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze sales performance and suggest improvements. Proactive, target-oriented, and able to thrive in a dynamic sales environment.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper
jobs.description: Bookkeeper Supervisor Tentang Perusahaan & Peran Kami sedang mencari seorang Bookkeeper yang teliti, terstruktur, dan proaktif untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Bali (Office Bali) . Dalam peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pembukuan harian, memastikan keakuratan pencatatan keuangan, serta menjaga kepatuhan terhadap standar akuntansi dan regulasi perpajakan yang berlaku. Tanggung Jawab Utama (Job Description) Pengawasan & Pengelolaan Operasional: Mengawasi dan meninjau aktivitas pembukuan harian, termasuk verifikasi transaksi Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), dan rekonsiliasi bank. Manajemen Buku Besar: Memastikan keakuratan pencatatan jurnal umum, penyesuaian ( adjustments ), dan pemeliharaan general ledger . Pelaporan Keuangan: Menyusun dan mereview laporan keuangan periodik (neraca, laba rugi, arus kas) secara tepat waktu untuk diserahkan kepada manajemen. Kepatuhan Pajak: Membantu perhitungan, pelaporan, dan kepatuhan perpajakan perusahaan (PPh, PPN) sesuai aturan yang berlaku di Indonesia. Pengembangan Proses & Internal Control: Mengidentifikasi area perbaikan pada alur kerja keuangan dan menerapkan prosedur kontrol internal yang efisien. Kepemimpinan Tim: Membimbing dan memberikan dukungan teknis kepada staf akuntansi/pembukuan di bawah supervisi Anda. Persyaratan & Kualifikasi (Requirements) Pendidikan: Minimal S1 Akuntansi, Keuangan, atau bidang relevan lainnya. Pengalaman Kerja: Memiliki pengalaman 1 tahun sebagai bookkeeper atau posisi setara. Keterampilan Teknis: Mahir menggunakan perangkat lunak akuntansi (seperti Accurate, Xero, QuickBooks, atau SAP). Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, Pivot Table, dan formula analisis data). Memahami dengan baik standar akuntansi keuangan (PSAK) dan regulasi perpajakan Indonesia. Keterampilan Interpersonal & Lainnya: Memiliki kejelian serta ketelitian yang tinggi ( attention to detail ) terhadap angka dan data. Bersedia ditempatkan di Bali .

jobs.title: Waiter / Waitress
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Waiter/Waitress yang berdedikasi dan profesional untuk bergabung dengan tim layanan pelanggan kami di PT Reins Marindo Indonesia yang berlokasi di Denpasar, Bali. Sebagai Waiter/Waitress, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam memberikan pengalaman bersantap yang luar biasa kepada setiap tamu kami. Posisi ini memerlukan individu yang ramah, terorganisir, dan memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang kuat untuk melayani dengan standar tinggi dalam lingkungan yang dinamis dan ramah. Jabatan ini merupakan pekerjaan kontrak yang menawarkan kesempatan untuk bekerja dalam industri perhotelan dan pariwisata yang berkembang pesat di Bali. Tanggung Jawab Menyambut tamu dengan ramah dan profesional saat mereka tiba di restoran atau area dining. Mengantar tamu ke meja mereka dan memberikan menu serta informasi tentang hidangan spesial dan penawaran kami. Menjelaskan menu dengan detail, menjawab pertanyaan tamu, dan memberikan rekomendasi makanan dan minuman berdasarkan preferensi mereka. Mengambil pesanan makanan dan minuman dengan akurat dan profesional, memastikan semua preferensi khusus dicatat dengan benar. Mengirimkan pesanan ke dapur dan bar dengan cepat dan efisien. Menata meja dengan rapi sesuai standar restoran sebelum dan sesudah setiap layanan. Menyajikan makanan dan minuman dengan presentasi yang menarik dan pengetahuan tentang setiap hidangan. Memastikan tamu puas dengan makanan dan minuman mereka, dan menangani keluhan atau permintaan khusus dengan profesionalisme. Melakukan clearing dan pembersihan meja dengan cepat dan higienis di antara setiap pesanan. Memproses pembayaran dengan akurat dan memberikan layanan check-out yang ramah. Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area dining serta mematuhi standar kesehatan dan keselamatan kerja. Berkolaborasi dengan rekan kerja dan tim dapur untuk memastikan operasional yang lancar dan pengalaman tamu yang optimal. Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau setara dengan pengalaman di industri perhotelan atau restoran. Pengalaman minimal 1-2 tahun sebagai Waiter/Waitress di restoran, hotel, atau establishment perhotelan serupa. Pengetahuan tentang prosedur layanan meja standar internasional dan etika pelayanan yang baik. Kemampuan komunikasi yang sangat baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan kemampuan berbahasa Inggris yang memadai akan menjadi nilai tambah. Keterampilan interpersonal yang kuat dengan kemampuan untuk berinteraksi dengan tamu dari berbagai latar belakang budaya. Ketangkasan fisik untuk berdiri dalam waktu lama, membawa beban, dan bergerak dengan cepat dalam lingkungan yang ramai. Perhatian terhadap detail dengan kemampuan mengingat pesanan dan preferensi tamu dengan akurat. Sikap profesional, ramah, dan orientasi terhadap kepuasan pelanggan. Kemampuan bekerja dalam tim dengan baik dan beradaptasi dengan berbagai situasi. Kepemilikan grooming dan penampilan yang rapi sesuai dengan standar restoran. Manfaat Gaji kompetitif dan insentif berbasis kinerja sesuai dengan standar industri perhotelan. Peluang pengembangan karier dan pelatihan berkelanjutan dalam keterampilan layanan pelanggan. Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung dengan tim yang kooperatif dan manajemen yang profesional. Lokasi kerja yang strategis di Denpasar, Bali dengan akses mudah ke fasilitas umum. Kesempatan untuk bekerja dalam industri pariwisata yang dinamis dengan interaksi multicultural. Asuransi kesehatan dasar dan tunjangan kesejahteraan karyawan sesuai ketentuan. Cuti berkala dan hari libur nasional sesuai peraturan yang berlaku. Bonus dan insentif khusus pada periode tertentu. Tentang Kami PT Reins Marindo Indonesia adalah perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang industri perhotelan dan pariwisata yang berlokasi di Denpasar, Bali. Kami berkomitmen untuk memberikan pengalaman terbaik kepada setiap tamu melalui layanan berkualitas tinggi dan profesional. Dengan tim yang berdedikasi dan fasilitas modern, kami menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang mendukung perkembangan karier karyawan. Perusahaan kami menghargai integritas, keunggulan layanan pelanggan, dan inovasi dalam setiap aspek operasional. Kami percaya bahwa kepuasan tamu dimulai dari kepuasan dan profesionalisme tim kami, dan kami berinvestasi dalam pengembangan talenta lokal untuk mendukung pertumbuhan industri pariwisata di Bali. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda tertarik dengan kesempatan ini dan memenuhi kualifikasi yang diperlukan, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Bergabunglah dengan tim kami dan jadilah bagian dari pengalaman berkesan bagi setiap tamu kami di PT Reins Marindo Indonesia!

jobs.title: Marketing Supervisor
jobs.description: Job Description : 1. Riset Pasar (Market Research) Melakukan riset dan analisis pasar Indonesia secara menyeluruh untuk mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, tren pasar, serta kebutuhan pelanggan. Menyusun rekomendasi strategi bisnis yang sesuai dengan kondisi dan karakteristik pasar lokal agar dapat diimplementasikan secara efektif. 2. Pengembangan Pelanggan & Kemitraan Mengidentifikasi dan mengembangkan calon pelanggan (misalnya retailer, distributor, atau agen) serta mitra bisnis potensial (misalnya penyedia layanan lokal). Membangun dan menjaga hubungan kerja sama dengan calon mitra, termasuk melakukan negosiasi awal, koordinasi uji coba kerja sama, hingga proses penandatanganan perjanjian atau pelaksanaan pilot project. 3. Eksekusi Operasional Bisnis Mengelola dan memantau keseluruhan proses kerja sama bisnis, mulai dari koordinasi pesanan, pengiriman produk, hingga tindak lanjut layanan purna jual. Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis umpan balik pelanggan, serta menyusun laporan aktivitas dan kinerja bisnis secara berkala sebagai dasar evaluasi dan pengembangan bisnis. Kualifikasi 1. Pemahaman Pasar Lokal Memahami budaya, karakteristik pasar, serta lingkungan bisnis di Indonesia. 2. Pendidikan & Pengalaman Lulusan minimal S1 dari perguruan tinggi terakreditasi di Indonesia atau Tiongkok. Memiliki pengalaman kerja 1–3 tahun di bidang yang relevan, terutama pada industri ritel, distribusi, atau bisnis offline. 3. Kemampuan Bahasa Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Mandarin dan/atau Bahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. 4. Pengalaman Industri Memiliki pengalaman kerja di industri ritel, FMCG, perdagangan, distribusi, atau bisnis fisik/offline. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, serta pengembangan relasi bisnis yang baik.

jobs.title: Quality Control Cengkeh (Clove)
jobs.description: Kesempatan Kami mencari Quality Control Cengkeh yang berdedikasi dan berpengalaman untuk bergabung dengan tim kami di Sahabat Prospera Nusantara. Sebagai Quality Control Cengkeh, Anda akan memainkan peran krusial dalam memastikan bahwa setiap produk cengkeh memenuhi standar kualitas internasional dan regulasi yang ketat sebelum distribusi ke pasar global. Kandidat yang ideal memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang karakteristik produk cengkeh, keahlian dalam pengujian kualitas, dan komitmen terhadap excellence dalam quality assurance. Jabatan ini merupakan posisi fulltime di lokasi Makassar, Sulawesi Selatan. Melakukan inspeksi menyeluruh terhadap cengkeh untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan spesifikasi kualitas yang telah ditetapkan. Menguji karakteristik fisik cengkeh termasuk ukuran, warna, kadar air, dan aroma sesuai dengan standar industri dan persyaratan pelanggan. Mendokumentasikan hasil pemeriksaan dan pengujian dengan detail yang akurat menggunakan sistem quality control yang tersedia. Mengidentifikasi produk yang tidak sesuai standar dan melaporkan temuan kepada manajemen untuk tindakan korektif yang diperlukan. Melakukan sampling dan pengujian batch secara berkala untuk memastikan konsistensi kualitas. Memastikan compliance terhadap standar internasional seperti ISO dan regulasi yang berlaku. Memelihara peralatan pengujian dan kalibrasi instrumen quality control sesuai jadwal yang ditentukan. Persyaratan Pendidikan minimal SMK/SMA atau setara dengan pengalaman relevan di bidang quality control atau agricultural products. Minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman dalam quality control, khususnya dalam industri pertanian, perkebunan, atau produk sejenis. Pengetahuan praktis tentang karakteristik dan standar kualitas cengkeh serta produk rempah lainnya. Keahlian dalam penggunaan alat pengujian standar seperti moisture meter, color checker, dan peralatan quality control lainnya. Kemampuan membaca dan memahami standar kualitas internasional dan spesifikasi teknis produk. Keterampilan komunikasi yang baik dalam bahasa Indonesia dan kemampuan membuat laporan tertulis yang jelas dan akurat. Perhatian terhadap detail yang tinggi dengan kemampuan analitis yang kuat dalam mengevaluasi kualitas produk. Disiplin tinggi, tanggung jawab, dan komitmen terhadap standar keselamatan kerja dan hygiene. Manfaat Gaji yang kompetitif sesuai dengan pengalaman dan kinerja Anda. Cuti tahunan dan cuti khusus sesuai dengan peraturan ketenagakerjaan. Peluang pengembangan karier dan pelatihan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan keterampilan quality control Anda. Lingkungan kerja yang professional dan mendukung dengan tim yang kolaboratif. Tentang Kami Sahabat Prospera Nusantara adalah perusahaan pengolahan pertanian (PT-PMA) yang berbasis di Makassar, yang mengkhususkan diri dalam komoditas premium Indonesia, termasuk jagung, kakao, kopi, dan rempah-rempah. Dengan menggunakan model pembiayaan strategis, perusahaan ini memperoleh bahan baku dari pengumpul lokal, mengolahnya untuk memenuhi standar kualitas yang ketat, dan secara andal memasok industri-industri besar. Dengan menyediakan input pertanian penting dan pembiayaan mikro, kami secara aktif mendukung petani lokal dan mendorong inovasi berkelanjutan di seluruh rantai pasokan regional. Lamar Sekarang Jika Anda memenuhi kriteria di atas dan tertarik untuk bergabung dengan tim Sahabat Prospera Nusantara, kami mengundang Anda untuk melamar sekarang. Kirimkan CV Anda beserta surat lamaran yang menjelaskan pengalaman dan motivasi Anda. Kami menantikan kesempatan untuk berbicara dengan Anda tentang bagaimana Anda dapat berkontribusi pada kesuksesan kami.

jobs.title: Shipping Agency Manager
jobs.description: As the Shipping Agency Manager, you will oversee the end-to-end ship agency operations across multiple ports in Indonesia, ensuring smooth vessel operations, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Key responsibilities: Manage the full cycle of ship agency operations for bulk and general cargo vessels, including vessel arrival, customs and port clearance, cargo operations, and departure formalities. Lead and supervise local field operations teams, including manpower planning, shift scheduling, task allocation, coaching, and performance management. Build and maintain strong relationships with maritime authorities, customs, immigration, quarantine, port operators, pilot stations, tugboat providers, and other key stakeholders. Coordinate with headquarters, international shipowners, vessel masters, and business partners regarding voyage planning, operational updates, and issue resolution in English. Review and control port charges, agency payment, vessel-related expenses, demurrage/despatch costs, and ensure accurate billing, reconciliation, cost control, and payment collection. Ensure full compliance with Indonesian maritime, customs, immigration, environmental, and taxation regulations to minimize operational and legal risks. Handle operational emergencies, including crew changes, repatriation, vessel supplies, spare parts delivery, fumigation, waste disposal, cargo disputes, and cargo damage claims. Prepare operational reports, maintain business records, analyze operational performance, optimize workflows, achieve business KPIs, and support business development initiatives. Requirements: Minimum 3 years of experience managing full-cycle ship agency operations in Indonesia. Strong knowledge of ship agency processes for bulk and general cargo vessels. In-depth understanding of Indonesian maritime regulations, customs procedures, and port clearance requirements. Proven experience working with government authorities and resolving operational or emergency issues. Fluent in English with the ability to communicate directly with international shipowners and vessel masters. Strong understanding of port cost structures, financial reconciliation, and operational cost control. Demonstrated leadership experience managing field operations and cross-functional teams across multiple ports. Excellent problem-solving, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Willing to travel frequently between ports across Indonesia.

jobs.title: Decorative Project (Sales Representative) - Makassar
jobs.description: Jotun is expanding rapidly in Indonesia and seeking a dynamic and ambitious professional to strengthen Decorative Project department as Decorative Project Consultant/ Sales Representative on Sulawesi area. The successful candidate will sell and promote decorative products to current customers and seek new potentials in the designated area by providing professional sales service, monitoring collection, coordinating with other departments, and responding quickly to meet customers' request to ensure the budgeted sales, market shares, gross margin, DSO target, and excellent customers satisfaction are achieved. This position will be covering Sulawesi area, based in Makassar (South Sulawesi) and report directly to Decorative Project Manager - East Area. Job Descriptions Achieve sales target by maintaining current customers and seek for new potential customers to ensure the budgeted sales is achieved and gross margin increased. Promote Decorative products by coordinating with the Marketing and Technical team to secure new customers and increase brand awareness in order to have more market share in the respective area. Monitor collection by following up collection and coordinating with Finance Department to ensure customer payment is received within the agreed term to achieve budgeted days outstanding (DSO) target. Provide high-quality product and professional sales services by coordinating with other departments to ensure customer's satisfaction is achieved. Job Requirements Bachelor degree from any discipline. At least 3 year(s) of working experience as sales engineer in the related field, building materials, especially in the construction project, real estate or construction market. Has a driven personality, able to convince and persuade others. Presentation and communication skills are required. Must have good command in English. Has own car and driving license A. Willing to be mobile all Sulawesi and East Indonesia area.

Makassar", "abstract": "Jotun is expanding rapidly in Indonesia and seeking dynamic professional to strengthen Decorative Project department as Sales Representative - Makasar", "content2": "

Jotun is expanding rapidly in Indonesia and seeking a dynamic and ambitious professional to strengthen Decorative Project department as Decorative Project Consultant/ Sales Representative on Sulawesi area.

The successful candidate will sell and promote decorative products to current customers and seek new potentials in the designated area by providing professional sales service, monitoring collection, coordinating with other departments, and responding quickly to meet customers' request to ensure the budgeted sales, market shares, gross margin, DSO target, and excellent customers satisfaction are achieved.

This position will be covering Sulawesi area, based in Makassar (South Sulawesi) and report directly to Decorative Project Manager - East Area.

Job Descriptions

  • Achieve sales target by maintaining current customers and seek for new potential customers to ensure the budgeted sales is achieved and gross margin increased.

  • Promote Decorative products by coordinating with the Marketing and Technical team to secure new customers and increase brand awareness in order to have more market share in the respective area.

  • Monitor collection by following up collection and coordinating with Finance Department to ensure customer payment is received within the agreed term to achieve budgeted days outstanding (DSO) target.

  • Provide high-quality product and professional sales services by coordinating with other departments to ensure customer's satisfaction is achieved.


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor degree from any discipline.

  • At least 3 year(s) of working experience as sales engineer in the related field, building materials, especially in the construction project, real estate or construction market.

  • Has a driven personality, able to convince and persuade others.

  • Presentation and communication skills are required.

  • Must have good command in English.

  • Has own car and driving license A.

  • Willing to be mobile all Sulawesi and East Indonesia area.

jobs.title: Internal Audit Staff
jobs.description: Pendidikan minimal S1 Akuntansi. Memiliki pengalaman 1- 2 tahun pada bidang Internal Audit/Audit, atau Fresh Graduate dipersilakan melamar. Memahami sistem pengendalian internal, manajemen risiko, proses audit, SOP, dan alur proses bisnis. Memahami end-to-end proses audit beserta istilah dan teknis di dalamnya. Menguasai Microsoft Office, terutama Microsost Excel. Familiar dengan SAP/IFCA menjadi nilai tambah. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas ke luar kota. Melaksanakan pemeriksaan pada divisi terkait sesuai prosedur dan program audit yang telah ditentukan. Mengumpulkan, memeriksa, dan menganalisis data serta dokumen untuk mengidentifikasi temuan pemeriksaan. Melakukan klarifikasi dan koordinasi dengan departemen terkait atas hasil pemeriksaan. Membantu menyusun laporan hasil pemeriksaan beserta rekomendasi perbaikan. Melakukan monitoring dan dokumentasi atas tindak lanjut perbaikan yang dilakukan oleh auditee.

jobs.title: Accounting & Tax Officer
jobs.description: Job Description Manage daily accounting and tax transactions in a timely and accurate manner. Coordinate with internal and external teams to obtain missing documents and clarify accounting transactions. Perform the full accounting cycle, from reviewing source documents and preparing journal entries to the preparation of financial statements. Prepare and maintain the General Ledger, review account movements, and investigate unusual or unexplained changes. Prepare accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, adjusting entries, and reversal entries as part of the monthly closing process. Assist in preparing other related working papers for internal reporting as part of the monthly closing process. Review payment vouchers and prepare withholding tax (WHT) certificates. Prepare tax calculations and tax reports in accordance with applicable tax regulations. Assist in preparing documents and supporting schedules for internal and external audits, tax reviews, and other compliance requirements. Manage and maintain documents in paper or electronic filing systems in timely and accurate manner. Requirements Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Fiscal Administration, or other related fields from a reputable institution or university. High integrity in in performing assigned responsibilities. Proficiency in English both verbal and written. Strong multitasking and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively. Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to work accurately. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel. Strong work ethic and the ability to handle confidential information appropriately. Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to take initiative, streamline workflows, and solve problems independently. Preferred Strong understanding of PSAK and IFRS. Previous experience in an accounting, tax, audit, or consulting firm. Have Tax Brevet A/B Certificate or any Accounting Certificate from reputable organizations. Experience in using Odoo and Talenta. Strong interest in utilizing technology to improve work efficiency.

jobs.description: PT Duta Abadi Primantara is looking for a creative and detail-oriented Interior Design Staff to join our Marketing – Creative Design team. What You’ll Do Create interior designs for company properties based on business needs and company guidelines. Develop and revise designs based on feedback from supervisors and stakeholders. Conduct site visits, measurements, and site documentation to ensure accurate and implementable designs. Coordinate with internal teams, contractors, and external parties during the design and implementation process. Support continuous improvement initiatives and ensure compliance with company standards. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Interior Design or a related field. Fresh graduates are welcome; minimum 1 year of experience in interior design is a plus. Experience in retail, exhibition, or commercial design is preferred. Proficient in AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3Ds Max , or similar design software. Familiar with Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator for visual presentations. Good understanding of aesthetics, ergonomics, and space functionality . Able to conduct site measurements and identify technical challenges. Creative, detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to work in a dynamic environment. Portfolio is required. Why Join Us? ✨ Opportunity to work on diverse commercial & retail projects ✨ Career development and learning opportunities ✨ Collaborative and supportive working environment ✨ Opportunity to contribute your creativity to a growing business 📩 Interested? Apply now and join our team!
